title.zh: 卷一百 志第四十八: 兵三
title.raw: 卷一百 志第四十八: 兵三 Volume 100 Treatises 53: Military 3

sentences.zh: 兵三 ○馬政

translations.literal: Military 3 ○ Horse Administration
translations.idiomatic: Military 3 — Horse Administration

sentences.zh: 西北馬多天下，秦、漢而下，載籍蓋可考已。

translations.literal: The northwest has the most horses under Heaven; from the Qin and Han dynasties downward, this may generally be verified in the written records.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest possessed the finest horses in the realm, and from the Qin and Han dynasties onward this fact is amply documented in the historical records.

sentences.zh: 元起朔方，俗善騎射，因以弓馬之利取天下，古或未之有。

translations.literal: The Yuan arose in the northern frontier; their custom excelled in mounted archery, and by the advantage of bow and horse they took the realm—perhaps never matched in antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan dynasty rose from the northern frontier, where the people excelled at mounted archery; relying on the superiority of bow and horse they conquered the empire—an achievement perhaps without parallel in antiquity.

sentences.zh: 蓋其沙漠萬里，牧養蕃息，太僕之馬，殆不可以數計，亦一代之盛哉。

translations.literal: For their desert stretches ten thousand li, pasturage flourished and multiplied, and the horses of the Imperial Pasturage could scarcely be counted—truly the splendor of an age.
translations.idiomatic: Across deserts ten thousand li wide their herds multiplied without end; the horses under the Imperial Pasturage could hardly be numbered at all—such was the magnificence of that dynasty.

sentences.zh: 世祖中統四年，設群牧所，隸太府監。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongtong under Shizu, the Pasturage Office was established, subordinate to the Imperial Treasury Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Zhongtong era, Emperor Shizu established the Pasturage Office under the Imperial Treasury Directorate.

sentences.zh: 尋升尚牧監，又升太僕院，改衛尉院。

translations.literal: Soon it was promoted to the Superior Pasturage Directorate, then again to the Imperial Pasturage Court, and renamed the Court of Palace Receptions.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon elevated to the Superior Pasturage Directorate, then to the Imperial Pasturage Court, and later renamed the Court of Palace Receptions.

sentences.zh: 院廢，立太僕寺，屬之宣徽院。

translations.literal: When the court was abolished, the Imperial Pasturage Temple was established, subordinate to the Xuanhui Court.
translations.idiomatic: When that court was abolished, the Imperial Pasturage Temple was founded and placed under the Xuanhui Court.

sentences.zh: 後隸中書省，典掌御位下、大斡耳朵馬。

translations.literal: Later it was subordinated to the Secretariat and managed the horses of the Imperial Presence and the Great Ordo.
translations.idiomatic: It was later placed under the Secretariat and charged with the horses of the Imperial Presence and the Great Ordo.

sentences.zh: 其牧地，東越耽羅，北踰火裏禿麻，西至甘肅，南暨雲南等地，凡一十四處，自上都、大都以至玉你伯牙、折連怯呆兒，周回萬里，無非牧地。

translations.literal: Its pasturage lands extended east beyond Tamna, north beyond Qoliyutama, west to Gansu, and south to Yunnan and other regions—fourteen districts in all; from Shangdu and Dadu to Yuniboya and Jelenchede'er, circling ten thousand li, all were pasturage.
translations.idiomatic: Its grazing grounds reached east beyond Tamna, north beyond Qoliyutama, west to Gansu, and south into Yunnan—fourteen districts in all. From Shangdu and Dadu to Yuniboya and Jelenchede'er, a circuit of ten thousand li was devoted entirely to pasturage.

sentences.zh: 馬之群，或千百，或三五十，左股烙以官印，號大印子馬。

translations.literal: Herds of horses numbered sometimes a thousand or a hundred, sometimes thirty or fifty; the left thigh was branded with the official seal and they were called great seal-brand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Horse herds ranged from a few dozen to several thousand; the left thigh was branded with the official seal, and these were known as great seal-brand horses.

sentences.zh: 其印有兵古、貶古、闊卜川、月思古、斡欒等名。

translations.literal: The brands bore such names as Binggu, Biangu, Kuobuchuan, Yuesigu, Woluan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The brands bore such names as Binggu, Biangu, Kuobuchuan, Yuesigu, Woluan, and the like.

sentences.zh: 牧人曰哈赤、哈剌赤；

translations.literal: Herdsmen were called qachi and qarajin;
translations.idiomatic: The herdsmen were called qachi and qarajin;

sentences.zh: 有千戶、百戶，父子相承任事。

translations.literal: there were thousand-households and hundred-households, father and son succeeding one another in office.
translations.idiomatic: with thousand-household and hundred-household officers who passed their duties from father to son.

sentences.zh: 自夏及冬，隨地之宜，行逐水草，十月各至本地。

translations.literal: From summer through winter they followed the suitability of the land, moving after grass and water; in the tenth month each returned to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: From summer through winter they followed the seasons, driving their herds after grass and water; in the tenth month each returned to his home pasture.

sentences.zh: 朝廷歲以九月、十月遣寺官馳驛閱視，較其多寡，有所產駒，即烙印取勘，收除見在數目，造蒙古、回回、漢字文冊以聞，其總數蓋不可知也。

translations.literal: Each year in the ninth and tenth months the court dispatched temple officials by relay post to inspect, comparing their numbers; any foals born were immediately branded and checked, the current count recorded and deducted, registers in Mongol, Uighur, and Chinese script were made and reported—the grand total could scarcely be known.
translations.idiomatic: Every year in the ninth and tenth months the court sent temple officials by relay to inspect the herds and compare their numbers. Newborn foals were branded and registered at once, current totals were tallied, and reports were drawn up in Mongol, Uighur, and Chinese script—but the grand total could scarcely be known.

sentences.zh: 凡病死者三，則令牧人償大牝馬一，二則償二歲馬一，一則償牝羊一，其無馬者以羊、駝、牛折納。

translations.literal: Whenever three died of illness, the herdsman was made to compensate with one adult mare; for two, one two-year-old horse; for one, one ewe; those without horses compensated in sheep, camels, or cattle at converted rates.
translations.idiomatic: If three horses died of illness, the herdsman had to replace them with one adult mare; for two deaths, one two-year-old horse; for one death, one ewe. Herdsmen without horses paid compensation in sheep, camels, or cattle at the prescribed conversion rates.

sentences.zh: 太廟祀事暨諸寺影堂用乳酪，則供牝馬；

translations.literal: For the Imperial Ancestral Temple sacrifices and the portrait halls of the various temples that used dairy products, mares were supplied;
translations.idiomatic: For sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and for the portrait halls of the various temples that required dairy products, mares were supplied;

sentences.zh: 駕仗及宮人出入，則供尚乘馬。

translations.literal: for imperial equipage and palace attendants going in and out, Superior Riding horses were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: for the imperial equipage and for palace attendants traveling in and out of the palace, Superior Riding horses were provided.

sentences.zh: 車駕行幸上都，太僕卿以下皆從，先驅馬出健德門外，取其肥可取乳者以行，汰其羸瘦不堪者還於群。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage traveled to Shangdu, the Imperial Pasturage minister and those below all followed; advance horses went out beyond Jiande Gate, taking those fat and fit for milking to go along, and rejecting the emaciated and unfit back to the herds.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor traveled to Shangdu, the minister of imperial pasturage and his subordinates accompanied him. Advance herds were driven out beyond Jiande Gate; the fattest mares suitable for milking went with the court, while the lean and unfit were culled back to the main herds.

sentences.zh: 自天子以及諸王百官，各以脫羅氈置撒帳，為取乳室。

translations.literal: From the Son of Heaven down to the princes and the hundred officials, each set up a felt tent with tuoluo felt as a milking chamber.
translations.idiomatic: From the emperor down to the princes and officials, each pitched a felt tent lined with tuoluo felt as a milking station.

sentences.zh: 車駕還京師，太僕卿先期遣使征馬五十醞都來京師。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, the Imperial Pasturage minister beforehand dispatched envoys to levy fifty ündür of horses to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor returned to the capital, the minister of imperial pasturage sent envoys ahead of time to bring fifty ündür teams of horses to the capital.

sentences.zh: 醞都者，承乳車之名也。

translations.literal: Ündür was the name of the milk-receiving cart.
translations.idiomatic: Ündür was the name given to the milk-collection wagons.

sentences.zh: 既至，俾哈赤、哈剌赤之在朝為卿大夫者，親秣飼之，日釀黑馬乳以奉玉食，謂之細乳。

translations.literal: When they arrived, qachi and qarajin who were at court as ministers and grandees were made personally to feed them; each day they fermented black mare's milk to present for the imperial meal—this was called fine milk.
translations.idiomatic: Once they arrived, qachi and qarajin who held ministerial rank at court fed the mares personally, fermenting black mare's milk daily for the imperial table—this was called fine milk.

sentences.zh: 每醞都，牝馬四十。

translations.literal: Each ündür had forty mares.
translations.idiomatic: Each ündür team comprised forty mares.

sentences.zh: 每牝馬一，官給芻一束、菽八升。

translations.literal: For each mare the government supplied one bundle of fodder and eight sheng of beans.
translations.idiomatic: For each mare the government issued one bundle of fodder and eight sheng of beans.

sentences.zh: 駒一，給芻一束、菽五升。

translations.literal: For each foal, one bundle of fodder and five sheng of beans.
translations.idiomatic: For each foal, one bundle of fodder and five sheng of beans were issued.

sentences.zh: 菽貴，則其半以小稻充。

translations.literal: When beans were costly, half was supplied in small rice instead.
translations.idiomatic: When beans were expensive, half the ration was supplied in hulled rice instead.

sentences.zh: 自諸王百官而下，亦有馬乳之供，醞都如前之數，而馬減四之一，謂之細乳。

translations.literal: From the princes and hundred officials downward there was also a supply of mare's milk; the number of ündür was as before, but the horses were reduced by one quarter—this was called fine milk.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and officials likewise received mare's milk; they were allotted the same number of ündür, but with one quarter fewer horses—this reduced supply was called the secondary milk service.

sentences.zh: 芻粟要旬取給於度支，寺官亦以旬詣閑廄閱肥瘠。

translations.literal: Fodder and grain were to be drawn every ten days from the revenue office; temple officials also every ten days went to the spare stables to inspect fatness and leanness.
translations.idiomatic: Fodder and grain rations were drawn every ten days from the revenue office, and temple officials likewise inspected the spare stables every ten days to check the horses' condition.

sentences.zh: 又自世祖而下山陵，各有醞都，取馬乳以供祀事，號金陵擠馬，越五年，盡以與守山陵使者。

translations.literal: Moreover, from Shizu downward each imperial tomb had its own ündür, taking mare's milk to supply sacrifices—called Jinling pressing horses; after five years they were all given to the envoys guarding the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: From Emperor Shizu onward each imperial tomb also maintained ündür teams to supply mare's milk for sacrifices—these were called the Jinling pressing horses. After five years they were turned over entirely to the tomb-guard envoys.

sentences.zh: 凡御位下、正宮位下、隨朝諸色目人員，甘肅、土番、耽羅、雲南、占城、蘆州、河西、亦奚卜薛、和林、斡難、怯魯連、阿剌忽馬乞、哈剌木連、亦乞裏思、亦思渾察、成海、阿察脫不罕、折連怯呆兒等處草地，內及江南、腹裏諸處，應有系官孳生馬、牛、駝、騾、羊點數之處，一十四道牧地，各千戶、百戶等名目如左：

translations.literal: All under the Imperial Presence, under the Principal Palace, and the various semuren personnel attached to the court; the pasturelands of Gansu, Tubo, Tamna, Yunnan, Champa, Luzhou, Hexi, Yixibuxue, Karakorum, the Onon, the Kerulen, Arqumaqi, Qarumughun, Yiqilisi, Yisihunucha, Chenghai, Achatobuhan, Jelenchede'er, and other places; within and in Jiangnan and the interior regions wherever state-registered breeding horses, cattle, camels, mules, and sheep were tallied—fourteen pasturage circuits; the thousand-households, hundred-households, and other titles for each are as follows:
translations.idiomatic: For all lands under the Imperial Presence, the Principal Palace, and the various semuren attached to the court—from Gansu, Tibet, Tamna, Yunnan, Champa, Luzhou, Hexi, Yixibuxue, Karakorum, the Onon, the Kerulen, Arqumaqi, Qarumughun, Yiqilisi, Yisihunucha, Chenghai, Achatobuhan, Jelenchede'er, and elsewhere—and within Jiangnan and the interior wherever state herds of horses, cattle, camels, mules, and sheep were registered, there were fourteen pasturage circuits. The thousand-household and hundred-household titles for each are listed below:

sentences.zh: 東路折連怯呆兒等處，玉你伯牙、上都周圍，哈剌木連等處，阿剌忽馬乞等處，斡斤川等處，阿察脫不罕等處，甘州等處，左手永平等處，右手固安州等處，雲南亦奚卜薛，蘆州，益都，火裏禿麻，高麗耽羅國。

translations.literal: Eastern circuit: Jelenchede'er and elsewhere; Yuniboya and the environs of Shangdu; Qarumughun and elsewhere; Arqumaqi and elsewhere; Wojinchuan and elsewhere; Achatobuhan and elsewhere; Ganzhou and elsewhere; left hand Yongping and elsewhere; right hand Gu'an Prefecture and elsewhere; Yunnan Yixibuxue; Luzhou; Yidu; Qoliyutama; Goryeo and the kingdom of Tamna.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern circuit comprised Jelenchede'er and related districts; Yuniboya and the Shangdu region; Qarumughun and related districts; Arqumaqi and related districts; Wojinchuan and related districts; Achatobuhan and related districts; Ganzhou and related districts; the left-hand Yongping circuit; the right-hand Gu'an Prefecture circuit; Yunnan Yixibuxue; Luzhou; Yidu; Qoliyutama; and Goryeo with the kingdom of Tamna.

sentences.zh: 一，折連怯呆兒等處御位下：折連怯呆兒地哈剌赤千戶買買、買的、撒臺、怯兒八思、闊闊來、塔失鐵木兒、哈剌那海、伯要<角┦>、也兒的思、撒的迷失、教化、太鐵木兒、塔都、也先、木薛肥、不思塔八、不兒都、麻失不顏臺、撒敦。

translations.literal: 1. Under the Imperial Presence at Jelenchede'er and elsewhere: at Jelenchede'er, qarajin thousand-households Maimai, Maidi, Satai, Qierbasi, Kuokuolai, Tashitemuer, Qaranaihai, Boyao Jir, Yierdesi, Sademishi, Jiaohua, Tataiemuer, Tadu, Yexian, Muxuefei, Busitaba, Buerdu, Mashibuyantai, Sadun.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Under the Imperial Presence in the Jelenchede'er district: qarajin thousand-households at Jelenchede'er—Maimai, Maidi, Satai, Qierbasi, Kuokuolai, Tashitemuer, Qaranaihai, Boyao Jir, Yierdesi, Sademishi, Jiaohua, Tataiemuer, Tadu, Yexian, Muxuefei, Busitaba, Buerdu, Mashibuyantai, and Sadun.

sentences.zh: 按赤、忽裏哈赤千戶下百戶脫脫木兒。

translations.literal: Under the qachi thousand-households of Anchi and Huli, the hundred-household Tuotuomuer.
translations.idiomatic: Under the qachi thousand-households of Anchi and Huli: the hundred-household Tuotuomuer.

sentences.zh: 兀魯兀內土阿八剌哈赤闊闊出。

translations.literal: At Wuluwuneitu, qachi Abarla, Kuokuochu.
translations.idiomatic: At Wuluwuneitu: qachi Abarla Kuokuochu.

sentences.zh: 徹徹地撒剌八。

translations.literal: At Cheche, Salaba.
translations.idiomatic: At Cheche: Salaba.

sentences.zh: 薛裏溫、你裏溫、斡脫忽赤、哈剌鐵木兒。

translations.literal: Xueliwen, Nilwen, Wotuohuchi, Qaratiemuer.
translations.idiomatic: Xueliwen, Nilwen, Wotuohuchi, and Qaratiemuer.

sentences.zh: 哈思罕地僧家奴。

translations.literal: At Hasihan, Sengjianu.
translations.idiomatic: At Hasihan: Sengjianu.

sentences.zh: 玉你伯牙斷頭山百戶哈只。

translations.literal: At Yuniboya Duantoushan, the hundred-household Hazhi.
translations.idiomatic: At Yuniboya, Duantoushan: the hundred-household Hazhi.

sentences.zh: 一，玉你伯牙等處御位下：玉你伯牙地哈剌赤百戶忽兒禿哈、兀都蠻、燕鐵木兒、暗出忽兒、也先禿滿、玉龍鐵木兒、月思哥、明裏不蘭。

translations.literal: 1. Under the Imperial Presence at Yuniboya and elsewhere: at Yuniboya, qarajin hundred-households Huerduha, Wuduman, Yantiemuer, Anchuhuer, Yexiantuman, Yulongtiemuer, Yuesige, Minglibulan.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Under the Imperial Presence in the Yuniboya district: qarajin hundred-households at Yuniboya—Huerduha, Wuduman, Yantiemuer, Anchuhuer, Yexiantuman, Yulongtiemuer, Yuesige, and Minglibulan.

sentences.zh: 大斡耳朵位下：乞剌裏郭羅赤馬某等。

translations.literal: Under the Great Ordo: Qiliguoluochi Mou and others.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Great Ordo: Qiliguoluochi Mou and others.

sentences.zh: 哈裏牙兒茍赤別鐵木兒。

translations.literal: Hariyaer, qachi Bietiemuer.
translations.idiomatic: At Hariyaer: qachi Bietiemuer.

sentences.zh: 伯只剌茍赤阿藍答兒。

translations.literal: Bozhila, qachi Alandaer.
translations.idiomatic: At Bozhila: qachi Alandaer.

sentences.zh: 阿察兒伯顏茍赤教化的等。

translations.literal: Achaboyan, qachi Jiaohua and others.
translations.idiomatic: At Achaboyan: qachi Jiaohua and others.

sentences.zh: 塔魯內亦兒哥赤、塔裏牙赤等。

translations.literal: Talune, yiergechi, taliyachi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: At Talune: yiergechi, taliyachi, and others.

sentences.zh: 伯只剌阿塔赤忽兒禿哈。

translations.literal: Bozhila, atachi Huerduha.
translations.idiomatic: At Bozhila: atachi Huerduha.

sentences.zh: 桃山太師月赤察兒分出鐵木兒等。

translations.literal: Taoshan, Grand Preceptor Yuechichaer's detached division, Tiemuer and others.
translations.idiomatic: At Taoshan: Grand Preceptor Yuechichaer's detached division—Tiemuer and others.

sentences.zh: 伯顏只魯幹阿塔赤禿忽魯等。

translations.literal: Boyanzhilugan, atachi Tuhulu and others.
translations.idiomatic: At Boyanzhilugan: atachi Tuhulu and others.

sentences.zh: 玉你伯牙奴禿赤、火你赤。

translations.literal: Yuniboya, nutuchi, Huonichi.
translations.idiomatic: At Yuniboya: nutuchi and Huonichi.

sentences.zh: 一，哈剌木連等處御位下：阿失溫忽都地八都兒。

translations.literal: 1. Under the Imperial Presence at Qarumughun and elsewhere: at Ashiwenhudu, Baduer.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Under the Imperial Presence in the Qarumughun district: at Ashiwenhudu, Baduer.

sentences.zh: 希徹禿地吉兒<角┦>。

translations.literal: At Xichedu, Jier Jir.
translations.idiomatic: At Xichedu: Jier Jir.

sentences.zh: 哈察木敦。

translations.literal: Qachamudun.
translations.idiomatic: Qachamudun.

sentences.zh: 火石腦兒哈塔、咬羅海牙、撒的。

translations.literal: Huoshinaoer: Hata, Yaoluohaiya, Sade.
translations.idiomatic: At Huoshinaoer: Hata, Yaoluohaiya, and Sade.

sentences.zh: 換撒裏真按赤哈答。

translations.literal: Huansalizhen, anchi Hada.
translations.idiomatic: At Huansalizhen: anchi Hada.

sentences.zh: 須知忽都哈剌赤別乞。

translations.literal: Xuzhihudu, qarajin Bieqi.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuzhihudu: qarajin Bieqi.

sentences.zh: 軍腦兒哈剌赤火羅思。

translations.literal: Junniaoer, qarajin Huoluosi.
translations.idiomatic: At Junniaoer: qarajin Huoluosi.

sentences.zh: 玉龍䩞徹。

translations.literal: Yulong Zhanche.
translations.idiomatic: Yulong Zhanche.

sentences.zh: 雲內州拙裏牙赤昌罕。

translations.literal: Yunnei Prefecture, zhuoliyachi Changhan.
translations.idiomatic: At Yunnei Prefecture: zhuoliyachi Changhan.

sentences.zh: 察罕腦兒欠昔思。

translations.literal: Chahannaoer, Qianxisi.
translations.idiomatic: At Chahannaoer: Qianxisi.

sentences.zh: 棠樹兒安魯罕。

translations.literal: Tangshuer, Anluhan.
translations.idiomatic: At Tangshuer: Anluhan.

sentences.zh: 石頭山禿忽魯。

translations.literal: Shitoushan, Tuhulu.
translations.idiomatic: At Shitoushan: Tuhulu.

translations.idiomatic: At Yabuhan, Nilwen: Tuotuomuer.

translations.idiomatic: At Kaicheng Circuit, Heishui River: Buhua.

sentences.zh: 大斡耳朵位下：完者。

translations.literal: Under the Great Ordo: Wanzhe.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Great Ordo: Wanzhe.

sentences.zh: 一，阿剌忽馬乞等處御位下：阿剌忽馬乞地哈剌赤百戶按不憐、乾鐵哥、火石鐵木兒、末赤、卯罕、不蘭奚、孛羅罕。

translations.literal: 1. Under the Imperial Presence at Arqumaqi and elsewhere: at Arqumaqi, qarajin hundred-households Anbulian, Qiantiege, Huoshitiemuer, Mochi, Maohan, Bulanxi, Boluohan.

sentences.zh: 怯魯連地哈剌赤千戶床八失，百戶怯兒的、小薛幹、別鐵列不作、孛羅、串都、也速、典列、坦的裏、也裏迷失、忙兀<角┦>。

sentences.zh: ○屯田

translations.literal: ○ Garrison Farming
translations.idiomatic: ○ Garrison Farming

sentences.zh: 古者寓兵於農，漢、魏而下，始置屯田為守邊之計。

translations.literal: In antiquity soldiers were quartered among farmers; from the Han and Wei dynasties downward, garrison farming was first established as a plan for defending the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the state quartered troops among the peasantry; from the Han and Wei dynasties onward, garrison colonies were first established to guard the frontiers.

sentences.zh: 有國者善用其法，則亦養兵息民之要道也。

translations.literal: When a state employs this method well, it is also an essential way to maintain the army while giving the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: States that applied the system effectively thereby sustained their armies while sparing the common people—an essential policy.

sentences.zh: 國初，用兵征討，遇堅城大敵，則必屯田以守之。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty, when troops were sent on campaign and encountered strong walled cities or powerful enemies, garrison farming was invariably established to hold them.
translations.idiomatic: In the founding campaigns, whenever the army met a formidable walled city or a powerful foe, garrison farming was invariably established to hold the position.

sentences.zh: 海內既一，於是內而各衛，外而行省，皆立屯田，以資軍餉。

translations.literal: Once the realm was unified, garrison farms were established within by each guard and without by each branch secretariat to supply military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: After the empire was unified, garrison farms were established within the realm at each guard and in each outer branch secretariat to supply military rations.

sentences.zh: 或因古之制，或以地之宜，其為慮蓋甚詳密矣。

translations.literal: Some followed ancient institutions, some suited local conditions—the planning was exceedingly thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Some followed ancient precedents and some adapted to local conditions; the planning was exceedingly thorough.

sentences.zh: 大抵芍陂、洪澤、甘、肅、瓜、沙，因昔人之制，其地利蓋不減於舊；

translations.literal: Generally Shaoqi, Hongze, Gan, Su, Guazhou, and Shazhou followed former systems, and their geographical advantages were scarcely less than in old times;
translations.idiomatic: In general Shaoqi, Hongze, Gan, Su, Guazhou, and Shazhou followed earlier systems, and their natural advantages were scarcely diminished from former times;

sentences.zh: 和林、陜西、四川等地，則因地之宜而肇為之，亦未嘗遺其利焉。

translations.literal: Karakorum, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other regions were first opened according to local suitability, and their benefits were never abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Karakorum, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other regions were first opened according to local conditions, and their benefits were never neglected.

sentences.zh: 至於雲南八番，海南、海北，雖非屯田之所，而以為蠻夷腹心之地，則又因制兵屯旅以控扼之。

translations.literal: As for Yunnan, the Eight Circuits, Hainan, and Haibei—though not places for garrison farming, being the heartland of the barbarian tribes—troops were stationed there by established practice to control and restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan, the Eight Circuits, Hainan, and Haibei were not classic garrison-farming regions, yet as the heartlands of frontier peoples troops were stationed there by standing practice to hold them in check.

sentences.zh: 由是而天下無不可屯之兵，無不可耕之地矣。

translations.literal: Thus throughout the realm there was no place where troops could not be garrisoned, no land that could not be cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: Thus throughout the realm there was no region where troops could not be stationed and no land that could not be tilled.

sentences.zh: 今故著其建置增損之概，而內外所轄軍民屯田，各以次列焉。

translations.literal: Now therefore the general outline of their establishment, increase, and reduction is recorded, and the military and civilian garrison farms under inner and outer jurisdiction are each listed in order.
translations.idiomatic: The general outline of their establishment and subsequent changes is therefore recorded here, with military and civilian garrison farms under inner and outer jurisdiction each listed in turn.

sentences.zh: 樞密院所轄

translations.literal: Under the Bureau of Military Affairs
translations.idiomatic: Under the Bureau of Military Affairs

sentences.zh: 左衛屯田：世祖中統三年三月，調樞密院二千人，於東安州南、永清縣東荒土及本衛元占牧地，立屯開耕，分置左右手屯田千戶所，為軍二千名，為田一千三百一十頃六十五畝。

translations.literal: Left Guard Garrison Farm: In the third month of the third year of Zhongtong under Shizu, two thousand men of the Bureau of Military Affairs were transferred to open cultivation on wasteland south of Dong'an Prefecture and east of Yongqing County and on the guard's original pasture lands, establishing left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices with two thousand soldiers and 1,310 qing 65 mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Left Guard Garrison Farm: In the third month of the third year of Zhongtong, Emperor Shizu transferred two thousand men from the Bureau of Military Affairs to open cultivation on wasteland south of Dong'an Prefecture and east of Yongqing County and on the guard's former pasture lands, establishing left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices with two thousand soldiers farming 1,310 qing and 65 mu.

sentences.zh: 右衛屯田：世祖中統三年三月，調本衛軍二千人，於永清、益津等處立屯開耕，分置左右手屯田千戶所。

translations.literal: Right Guard Garrison Farm: In the third month of the third year of Zhongtong under Shizu, two thousand men of this guard were transferred to open cultivation at Yongqing, Yijin, and other places, establishing left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard Garrison Farm: In the third month of the third year of Zhongtong, two thousand men of this guard were sent to open cultivation at Yongqing, Yijin, and elsewhere, with left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices established.

sentences.zh: 其屯軍田畝之數，與左衛同。

translations.literal: The number of garrison soldiers and field mu was the same as the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The number of garrison soldiers and field acreage matched the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 中衛屯田：世祖至元四年，於武清、香河等縣置立。

translations.literal: Central Guard Garrison Farm: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, it was established in Wuqing, Xianghe, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Central Guard Garrison Farm: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan, farms were established in Wuqing, Xianghe, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以各屯地界，相去百餘里，往來耕作不便，遷於河西務、荒莊、楊家口、青臺、楊家白等處。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, because the garrison lands were more than a hundred li apart and travel for cultivation was inconvenient, they were moved to Hexiwu, Huangzhuang, Yangjiakou, Qingtai, Yangjiabai, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, because the garrison plots lay more than a hundred li apart and travel was inconvenient, the farms were relocated to Hexiwu, Huangzhuang, Yangjiakou, Qingtai, Yangjiabai, and other sites.

sentences.zh: 其屯軍之數，與左衛同，為田一千三十七頃八十二畝。

translations.literal: The number of garrison soldiers was the same as the Left Guard, with 1,037 qing 82 mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison numbered the same as the Left Guard, with 1,037 qing and 82 mu under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 前衛屯田：世祖至元十五年九月，以各省軍人備侍衛者，於霸州、保定、涿州荒閑地土屯種，分置左右手屯田千戶所。

translations.literal: Forward Guard Garrison Farm: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, soldiers from the various provinces serving as palace guards were put to garrison farming on idle land in Bazhou, Baoding, and Zhuozhou, with left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices established.
translations.idiomatic: Forward Guard Garrison Farm: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, provincial soldiers serving as palace guards were set to garrison farming on idle lands in Bazhou, Baoding, and Zhuozhou, with left- and right-hand thousand-household offices established.

sentences.zh: 屯軍與左衛同，為田一千頃。

translations.literal: The garrison soldiers matched the Left Guard, with 1,000 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison matched the Left Guard in size, with 1,000 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 後衛屯田：置立歲月與前衛同。

translations.literal: Rear Guard Garrison Farm: The month and year of establishment were the same as the Forward Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Guard Garrison Farm: Established in the same month and year as the Forward Guard.

sentences.zh: 後以永清等處田畝低下，遷昌平縣之太平莊。

translations.literal: Later, because the fields at Yongqing and elsewhere were of poor quality, the farm was moved to Taipingzhuang in Changping County.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because the fields around Yongqing were poor, the farm was moved to Taipingzhuang in Changping County.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年五月，以太平莊乃世祖經行之地，營盤所在，春秋往來，牧放衛士頭匹，不宜與漢軍立屯，遂罷之，止於舊立屯所，耕作如故。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Taiding, because Taipingzhuang was ground over which Shizu had traveled and where encampments stood, and where imperial guards pastured their horses in spring and autumn, it was deemed unsuitable for Han troops to farm there; the move was revoked and cultivation continued at the original site.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of Taiding, Taipingzhuang was recognized as ground Shizu had traversed and where guard horses were pastured each spring and autumn; Han garrison troops were withdrawn from there, and farming resumed at the original sites.

sentences.zh: 屯軍與左衛同，為田一千四百二十八頃一十四畝。

translations.literal: The garrison soldiers matched the Left Guard, with 1,428 qing 14 mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison matched the Left Guard, with 1,428 qing and 14 mu of fields.

sentences.zh: 左翼屯田萬戶府：世祖至元二十六年二月，罷蒙古侍衛軍從人之屯田者，別以斡端、別十八里回還漢軍，及大名、衛輝兩翼新附軍，與前、後二衛迤東還戍士卒合並屯田，設左、右翼屯田萬戶府以領之。

translations.literal: Left-Flank Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, Mongol palace guards withdrawn from garrison farming were replaced by Han troops returned from Woduan and Biebashibali, newly attached troops of the two wings from Daming and Weihui, and eastern-returning garrison soldiers of the Forward and Rear guards, merged for garrison farming with left- and right-flank garrison-farming ten-thousand-household offices to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Left-Flank Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan, Mongol palace guards were withdrawn from garrison farming and replaced by Han troops from Woduan and Biebashibali, newly attached troops from Daming and Weihui, and eastern-returning soldiers of the Forward and Rear guards, organized under left- and right-flank ten-thousand-household offices.

sentences.zh: 遂於大都路霸州及河間等處立屯開耕，置漢軍左右手二千戶、新附軍六千戶所，為軍二千五十一名，為田一千三百九十九頃五十二畝。

translations.literal: Garrison farming was then opened at Bazhou in Dadu Circuit and Hejian and other places, with Han left- and right-hand two-thousand-household offices and newly attached six-thousand-household offices—2,051 soldiers and 1,399 qing 52 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Farms were opened at Bazhou in Dadu Circuit and in Hejian and elsewhere, with Han left- and right-hand two-thousand-household offices and a newly attached six-thousand-household office—2,051 soldiers farming 1,399 qing and 52 mu.

sentences.zh: 忠翊侍衛屯田：世祖至元二十九年十一月，命各萬戶府，摘大同、隆興、太原、平陽等處軍人四千名，於燕只哥赤斤地面及紅城周回，置立屯田，開耕荒田二千頃，仍命西京宣慰司領其事，後改立大同等處屯儲萬戶府以領之。

translations.literal: Loyal Support Palace Guard Garrison Farm: In the eleventh month of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, each ten-thousand-household office was ordered to select four thousand soldiers from Datong, Longxing, Taiyuan, Pingyang, and elsewhere for garrison farming on the Yanzhigezhijin tract and around Hongcheng, opening two thousand qing of wasteland; the Western Capital pacification commission supervised it, later replaced by the Datong and elsewhere Garrison-Storage Ten-Thousand-Household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Support Palace Guard Garrison Farm: In the eleventh month of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan, four thousand soldiers were selected from Datong, Longxing, Taiyuan, Pingyang, and elsewhere to farm the Yanzhigezhijin tract and lands around Hongcheng, opening two thousand qing of wasteland under the Western Capital pacification commission, later the Datong Garrison-Storage Ten-Thousand-Household Office.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德十一年，改侍衛親軍都指揮使司，仍領屯田。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade under Chengzong, it was changed to the Palace Guard Personal-Army Command, which still supervised garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Dade under Chengzong, it became the Palace Guard Personal-Army Command, which continued to oversee garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大四年，以黃華嶺新附屯田軍一千人並歸本衛，別立屯署。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida under Wuzong, one thousand soldiers of the Huanghualing newly attached garrison farm were merged into this guard and a separate garrison office established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida under Wuzong, one thousand soldiers from the Huanghualing newly attached garrison farm were merged into this guard under a separate garrison office.

sentences.zh: 是年，改大同侍衛為中都威衛，屬之徽政院，分屯軍二千置弩軍翼，止以二千人分置左右手屯田千戶所，黃華嶺新附軍屯如故。

translations.literal: That year Datong Palace Guard was changed to Central Capital Weiguard under the Xuanhui Court; two thousand garrison soldiers were assigned to a crossbow corps, two thousand were divided into left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices, and the Huanghualing newly attached garrison continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Datong guard became the Central Capital Weiguard under the Xuanhui Court: two thousand soldiers formed a crossbow corps, two thousand were divided into left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices, and the Huanghualing garrison continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 仁宗延祐二年，遷紅城屯軍於古北口、太平莊屯種。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou under Renzong, Hongcheng garrison soldiers were moved to garrison farming at Gubeikou and Taipingzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yanyou under Renzong, the Hongcheng garrison was relocated to farm at Gubeikou and Taipingzhuang.

sentences.zh: 五年，復簽中都威衛軍八百人，於左都威衛所轄地內別立屯署。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, eight hundred Central Capital Weiguard soldiers were again levied to establish a separate garrison office within lands under the Left Capital Weiguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, eight hundred more Weiguard soldiers were levied for a separate garrison office within the Left Capital Weiguard's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，罷左都威衛及太平莊、白草營等處屯田，復於紅城周回立屯，仍屬中都威衛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, garrison farms at the Left Capital Weiguard, Taipingzhuang, Baicaoying, and elsewhere were abolished; farming was restored around Hongcheng under the Central Capital Weiguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, farms at the Left Capital Weiguard, Taipingzhuang, Baicaoying, and elsewhere were abolished and farming restored around Hongcheng under the Central Capital Weiguard.

sentences.zh: 英宗至治元年，始改為忠翊侍衛，屯田如故，為田二千頃。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi under Yingzong, it was first changed to Loyal Support Palace Guard; garrison farming continued as before with two thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizhi under Yingzong, the unit was renamed Loyal Support Palace Guard; garrison farming continued with two thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 後移置屯所，不知其數。

translations.literal: Later the garrison sites were moved; the numbers are unknown.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison sites were later moved; their acreage is unknown.

sentences.zh: 左、右欽察衛屯田：世祖至元二十四年，發本衛軍一千五百一十二名，分置左右手屯田千戶所及欽察屯田千戶所，於清州等處屯田。

translations.literal: Left and Right Qincha Guard Garrison Farms: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, 1,512 soldiers of this guard were dispatched to left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices and a Qincha garrison-farming thousand-household office for farming at Qingzhou and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Qincha Guard Garrison Farms: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan, 1,512 soldiers of this guard were assigned to left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices and a Qincha garrison-farming thousand-household office at Qingzhou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 英宗至治二年，始分左、右欽察衛，以左右手屯田千戶所分屬之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizhi under Yingzong, left and right Qincha guards were first separated, and the left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices were divided between them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhizhi under Yingzong, separate left and right Qincha guards were formed, and the left- and right-hand garrison-farming thousand-household offices were divided accordingly.

sentences.zh: 文宗天歷二年，創立龍翊侍衛，復以隸焉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli under Wenzong, the newly established Dragon Escort Palace Guard was again placed under their authority.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianli under Wenzong, the newly established Dragon Escort Palace Guard was again placed under their authority.

sentences.zh: 為軍左手千戶所七百五名，右手千戶所四百三十七名，欽察千戶所八百名。

translations.literal: Soldiers: left-hand thousand-household office 705, right-hand 437, Qincha thousand-household office 800.
translations.idiomatic: The force comprised 705 soldiers in the left-hand thousand-household office, 437 in the right-hand office, and 800 in the Qincha thousand-household office.

sentences.zh: 為田左手千戶所一百三十七頃五十畝，右手千戶所二百一十八頃五十畝，欽察千戶所三百頃。

translations.literal: Fields: left-hand office 137 qing 50 mu, right-hand 218 qing 50 mu, Qincha office 300 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Fields totaled 137 qing 50 mu for the left-hand office, 218 qing 50 mu for the right-hand office, and 300 qing for the Qincha office.

sentences.zh: 宗仁衛屯田：英宗至治二年八月，發五衛漢軍二千人，於大寧等處創立屯田，分置兩翼屯田千戶所，為田二千頃。

translations.literal: Zongren Guard Garrison Farm: In the eighth month of the second year of Zhizhi under Yingzong, two thousand Han soldiers of the five guards were sent to establish garrison farming at Daning and elsewhere, with two-wing garrison-farming thousand-household offices and two thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Zongren Guard Garrison Farm: In the eighth month of the second year of Zhizhi, two thousand Han soldiers from the five guards established garrison farming at Daning and elsewhere under two-wing thousand-household offices, with two thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 永平屯田總管府：世祖至元二十四年八月，以北京采取材木百姓三千餘戶，於灤州立屯，設官署以領其事，為戶三千二百九十，為田一萬一千六百一十四頃四十九畝。

translations.literal: Yongping Garrison-Farming Chief Office: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, more than three thousand households of commoners who gathered timber in the northern capital were put to garrison farming at Luanzhou, with an administrative office established to supervise—3,290 households and 11,614 qing 49 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping Garrison-Farming Chief Office: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan, more than three thousand timber-gathering households of the northern capital were settled for garrison farming at Luanzhou under a supervisory office—3,290 households farming 11,614 qing and 49 mu.

sentences.zh: 營田提舉司：不詳其建置之始，其設立處所在大都漷州之武清縣，為戶軍二百五十三，民一千二百三十五，析居放良四百八十，不蘭奚二百三十二，火者一百七十口，獨居不蘭奚一十二口，黑瓦木丁八十二名，為田三千五百二頃九十三畝。

translations.literal: Camp-Field Intendant's Office: The date of establishment is unknown; it was located in Wuqing County, Huazhou, in Dadu Circuit—253 military households, 1,235 civilian households, 480 released bondservants, 232 Bulanxi, 170 fire-slaves, 12 solitary Bulanxi, 82 Qara Buddhist laymen, and 3,502 qing 93 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Camp-Field Intendant's Office: Its founding date is unknown; it stood in Wuqing County, Huazhou, Dadu Circuit—with 253 military households, 1,235 civilians, 480 released bondservants, and other categories totaling 3,502 qing and 93 mu.

sentences.zh: 廣濟署屯田：世祖至元二十二年正月，以崔黃口空城屯田，歲澇不收，遷於清、滄等處。

translations.literal: Extensive Relief Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, the garrison farm at the empty city of Cuihuangkou, which flooded yearly without harvest, was moved to Qing, Cang, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Extensive Relief Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan, the farm at flood-prone Cuihuangkou was relocated to Qing, Cang, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 後大司農寺以尚珍署舊領屯夫二百三十戶歸之，既又遷濟南、河間五百五十戶，平灤、真定、保定三路屯夫四五百十戶，並入本屯，為戶共一千二百三十，為田一萬二千六百頃三十八畝。

translations.literal: Later the Imperial Granary transferred 230 former Superior Delicacies Office garrison households; 550 households from Jinan and Hejian and four hundred fifty-odd from Pingluan, Zhending, and Baoding circuits were also merged—1,230 households and 12,626 qing 38 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Later 230 former Superior Delicacies Office households were added, with 550 from Jinan and Hejian and over 450 from Pingluan, Zhending, and Baoding—1,230 households farming 12,626 qing and 38 mu.

sentences.zh: 宣徽院所轄

translations.literal: Under the Xuanhui Court
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xuanhui Court

sentences.zh: 淮東淮西屯田打捕總官府：世祖至元十六年，募民開耕漣、海州荒地，官給禾種，自備牛具，所得子粒官得十之四，民得十之六，仍免屯戶徭役，屢欲中廢不果。

translations.literal: Huaidong-Huaixi Garrison-Farming and Hunting Chief Office: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, commoners were recruited to open the wasteland of Lian and Haizhou; the government supplied seed while they furnished oxen and tools; grain was divided four-tenths to the state and six-tenths to the farmers, and corvée for garrison households was remitted; repeated attempts to abolish it failed.
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong-Huaixi Garrison-Farming and Hunting Chief Office: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan, commoners were recruited to open wasteland in Lian and Haizhou; the government supplied seed while farmers furnished oxen and tools; harvests were split four-tenths to the state and six-tenths to the cultivators, with corvée remitted; repeated abolition attempts failed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，所轄提舉司一十九處並為十二。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the nineteen subordinate intendant's offices were merged into twelve.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, nineteen subordinate intendant's offices were consolidated into twelve.

sentences.zh: 其後再並，止設八處，為戶一萬一千七百四十三，為田一萬五千一百九十三頃三十九畝。

translations.literal: They were merged again afterward to eight sites—11,743 households and 15,193 qing 39 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Further consolidation left eight sites—11,743 households and 15,193 qing and 39 mu.

sentences.zh: 豐閏署：世祖至元二十二年，創立於大都路薊州之豐閏縣，為戶八百三十七，為田三百四十九頃。

translations.literal: Fengrun Office: Established in the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan under Shizu at Fengrun County, Jizhou, in Dadu Circuit—837 households and 349 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Fengrun Office: Established in the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan at Fengrun County, Jizhou, Dadu Circuit—837 households and 349 qing.

sentences.zh: 寶坻屯：世祖至元十六年，簽大都屬邑編民三百戶，立屯於大都之寶坻縣，為田四百五十頃。

translations.literal: Baodi Garrison: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, three hundred registered households of the Dadu metropolitan region were levied to establish a garrison at Baodi County in Dadu—450 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Baodi Garrison: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan, three hundred registered metropolitan households were settled at Baodi County in Dadu—450 qing.

sentences.zh: 尚珍署：世祖至元二十三年，置立於濟寧路之兗州，為戶四百五十六，為田九千七百一十九頃七十二畝。

translations.literal: Superior Delicacies Office: Established in the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan under Shizu at Yanzhou, Jining Circuit—456 households and 9,719 qing 72 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Superior Delicacies Office: Established in the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan at Yanzhou, Jining Circuit—456 households and 9,719 qing and 72 mu.

sentences.zh: 腹裏所轄軍民屯田

translations.literal: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Interior
translations.idiomatic: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Interior

sentences.zh: 大同等處屯儲總管屯田：成宗大德四年，以西京黃華嶺等處田土頗廣，發軍民九千餘人，立屯開耕。

translations.literal: Datong and Elsewhere Garrison-Storage Chief Garrison Farm: In the fourth year of Dade under Chengzong, because lands at Huanghualing and elsewhere in the Western Capital were extensive, more than nine thousand military and civilian personnel were sent to open cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Garrison-Storage Chief Garrison Farm: In the fourth year of Dade, because lands at Huanghualing near the Western Capital were extensive, more than nine thousand military and civilian personnel were sent to open cultivation.

sentences.zh: 六年，始設屯儲軍民總管萬戶府。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Garrison-Storage Military and Civilian Chief Ten-Thousand-Household Office was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the Garrison-Storage Military and Civilian Chief Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established.

sentences.zh: 十一年，放罷漢軍還紅城屯所，止存民夫在屯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Han troops were released to the Hongcheng garrison site; only civilian laborers remained.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Han garrison troops were released to Hongcheng; only civilian laborers remained.

sentences.zh: 仁宗時，改萬戶府為總管府，為戶軍四千二十，民五千九百四十五，為田五千頃。

translations.literal: Under Renzong the ten-thousand-household office was changed to a chief office—4,020 military households, 5,945 civilians, and 5,000 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Under Renzong the ten-thousand-household office became a chief office—4,020 military households, 5,945 civilians, and 5,000 qing.

sentences.zh: 虎賁親軍都指揮使司屯田：世祖至元十七年十二月，月兒魯官人言：「近於滅捏怯土、赤納赤、高州、忽蘭若班等處，改置驛傳，臣等議，可於舊置驛所設立屯田。」

translations.literal: Tiger Guard Personal-Army Command Garrison Farm: In the twelfth month of the seventeenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, the official Yierlu said: "Recently at Mienieqietu, Chunachi, Gaozhou, Hulanruoban, and other places relay stations were re-established; we propose garrison farming at the former relay sites."
translations.idiomatic: Tiger Guard Personal-Army Command Garrison Farm: In the twelfth month of the seventeenth year of Zhiyuan, Officer Yierlu memorialized: "Relay stations have been re-established at Mienieqietu, Chunachi, Gaozhou, Hulanruoban, and elsewhere; we propose garrison farming at the former relay sites."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，發虎賁親軍二千人入屯。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, two thousand Tiger Guard soldiers entered garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, two thousand Tiger Guard soldiers were assigned to garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，增軍一千，凡立三十四屯，於上都置司，為軍三千人，佃戶七十九，為田四千二百二頃七十九畝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the force was increased by one thousand; thirty-four garrisons were established with an office at Shangdu—3,000 soldiers, 79 tenant households, and 4,202 qing 79 mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, another thousand soldiers were added; thirty-four garrisons were established with an office at Shangdu—3,000 soldiers, 79 tenant households, and 4,202 qing and 79 mu.

sentences.zh: 嶺北行省屯田

translations.literal: Lingbei Branch Secretariat Garrison Farms
translations.idiomatic: Lingbei Branch Secretariat Garrison Farms

sentences.zh: 遼陽等處行中書省所轄屯田

translations.literal: Garrison Farms under the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Farms under the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 大寧路海陽等處打捕屯田所：世祖至元二十三年，以大寧、遼陽、平灤諸路拘刷漏籍、放良、孛蘭奚人戶，及僧道之還俗者，立屯於瑞州之西瀕海荒地開耕，設打捕屯田總管府。

translations.literal: Daning Circuit Haiyang and Elsewhere Hunting Garrison Office: In the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, unregistered, released, and Bulanxi households from Daning, Liaoyang, and Pingluan circuits and laicized monks and Daoists were settled to open coastal wasteland west of Ruizhou, with a hunting-garrison chief office established.
translations.idiomatic: Daning Circuit Haiyang Hunting Garrison Office: In the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan, unregistered, released, and Bulanxi households from Daning, Liaoyang, and Pingluan and laicized clergy were settled to open coastal wasteland west of Ruizhou under a hunting-garrison chief office.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德四年，罷之，止立打捕屯田所，為戶元撥並召募共一百二十二，為田二百三十頃五十畝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dade under Chengzong it was abolished; only a hunting garrison office remained—122 households originally levied and recruited, and 230 qing 50 mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dade it was abolished, leaving only a hunting garrison office—122 households and 230 qing and 50 mu.

sentences.zh: 浦峪路屯田萬戶府：世祖至元二十九年十月，為蠻軍三百戶、女直一百九十戶，於咸平府屯種。

translations.literal: Puyu Circuit Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office: In the tenth month of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, three hundred Mang troops and one hundred ninety Jurchen households were settled to farm at Xianping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Puyu Circuit Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office: In the tenth month of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan, three hundred Mang soldiers and one hundred ninety Jurchen households were settled to farm at Xianping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三十年，命本府萬戶和魯古<角┦>領其事，仍於茶剌罕、剌憐等處立屯。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Helugu Jir of this office was ordered to supervise it; garrisons were also established at Chalahuan and Laling.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Helugu Jir of this office was appointed to supervise it, with garrisons at Chalahuan and Laling.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，罷萬戶府屯田。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the ten-thousand-household garrison farm was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the ten-thousand-household garrison farm was abolished.

sentences.zh: 仁宗大德二年，撥蠻軍三百戶屬肇州蒙古萬戶府，止存女直一百九十戶，依舊立屯，為田四百頃。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dade under Renzong, three hundred Mang soldiers were assigned to the Zhaozhou Mongol Ten-Thousand-Household Office; only one hundred ninety Jurchen households remained under the original garrison—400 qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dade, three hundred Mang soldiers were transferred to the Zhaozhou Mongol Ten-Thousand-Household Office; one hundred ninety Jurchen households remained—400 qing.

sentences.zh: 金復州萬戶府屯田：世祖至元二十一年五月，發新附軍一千二百八十一戶，於忻都察置立屯田。

translations.literal: Jinfu Circuit Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the fifth month of the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, 1,281 newly attached households were sent to establish garrison farming at Xinducha.
translations.idiomatic: Jinfu Circuit Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the fifth month of the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan, 1,281 newly attached households established garrison farming at Xinducha.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，分京師應役新附軍一千人，屯田哈思罕關東荒地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, one thousand newly attached soldiers on metropolitan service were sent to farm wasteland east of Hasihan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, one thousand metropolitan-service newly attached soldiers farmed wasteland east of Hasihan Pass.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以玉龍帖木兒、塔失海牙兩萬戶新附軍一千三百六十戶，並入金復州，立屯耕作，為戶三千六百四十一，為田二千五百二十三頃。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, 1,360 newly attached households of the Yulongtiemuer and Tashihaiya ten-thousand-household offices were merged into Jinfu Circuit—3,641 households and 2,523 qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, 1,360 households of the Yulongtiemuer and Tashihaiya ten-thousand-household offices were merged into Jinfu Circuit—3,641 households and 2,523 qing.

sentences.zh: 河南行省所轄軍民屯田

translations.literal: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Henan Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Henan Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 南陽府民屯：世祖至元二年正月，詔孟州之東，黃河之北，南至八柳樹、枯河、徐州等處，凡荒閑地土，可令阿朮、阿剌罕等所領士卒，立屯耕種，並摘各萬戶所管漢軍屯田。

translations.literal: Nanyang Prefecture Civilian Garrison: In the first month of the second year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, an edict ordered that east of Mengzhou, north of the Yellow River, south to Baliu Tree, the withered river, Xuzhou, and other places—all idle land—might have soldiers led by Achu, Alahan, and others establish garrison farming, and Han troops under each ten-thousand-household office were also selected for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang Prefecture Civilian Garrison: In the first month of the second year of Zhiyuan, an edict directed that idle lands east of Mengzhou, north of the Yellow River, and south to Baliu Tree, the dry riverbed, Xuzhou, and beyond be opened by troops under Achu, Alahan, and others, with Han soldiers from each ten-thousand-household office also assigned.

sentences.zh: 六年，以攻襄樊軍餉不足，發南京、河南、歸德諸路編民二萬餘戶，於唐、鄧、申、裕等處立屯。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because provisions for the Xiang-Fan campaign were insufficient, more than twenty thousand registered households of Nanjing, Henan, Guide, and other circuits were sent to establish garrisons at Tang, Deng, Shen, and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, because supplies for the Xiangyang-Fancheng campaign were insufficient, more than twenty thousand registered households from Nanjing, Henan, Guide, and other circuits were settled at Tang, Deng, Shen, and Yu.

sentences.zh: 八年，散還元屯戶，別簽南陽諸色戶計，立營田使司領之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the original garrison households were dispersed and various Nanyang households were levied instead, with a camp-field intendant's office established to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the original garrison households were released and various Nanyang households levied instead under a camp-field intendant's office.

sentences.zh: 尋罷，改立南陽屯田總管府。

translations.literal: Soon it was abolished and changed to the Nanyang Garrison-Farming Chief Office.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon abolished and replaced by the Nanyang Garrison-Farming Chief Office.

sentences.zh: 後復罷，止隸有司，為戶六千四十一，為田一萬六百六十二頃七畝。

translations.literal: Later abolished again, it was placed only under local offices—6,041 households and 10,662 qing 7 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Later abolished again, it fell under local offices only—6,041 households and 10,662 qing and 7 mu.

sentences.zh: 洪澤萬戶府屯田：世祖至元二十三年，立洪澤南北三屯，設萬戶府以統之。

translations.literal: Hongze Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, three garrisons north and south of Hongze were established with a ten-thousand-household office to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Hongze Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the twenty-third year of Zhiyuan, three garrisons north and south of Hongze were established under a ten-thousand-household office.

sentences.zh: 先是，江淮行省言：「國家經費，糧儲為急，今屯田之利，無過兩淮，況芍陂、洪澤皆漢、唐舊嘗立屯之地，若令江淮新附漢軍屯田，可歲得糧百五十餘萬石。」

translations.literal: Previously the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat had said: "State expenditures urgently require grain stores; of all garrison-farming profits none surpass the two Huai regions; moreover Shaoqi and Hongze are both places where Han and Tang once established garrisons—if newly attached Han troops of Jianghuai are put to garrison farming, more than 1.5 million shi of grain might be gained yearly."
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Jianghuai branch secretariat had argued: "State expenditure depends above all on grain; no garrison-farming profit exceeds that of the two Huai regions; Shaoqi and Hongze are both sites where Han and Tang once farmed—if newly attached Han troops garrisoned there, more than 1.5 million shi might be harvested yearly."

sentences.zh: 至是從之。

translations.literal: At this the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was then approved.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，罷三屯萬戶，止立洪澤屯田萬戶府以統之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the three garrison ten-thousand-households were abolished; only the Hongze Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office remained to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the three garrison ten-thousand-household offices were abolished, leaving only the Hongze Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office.

sentences.zh: 其置立處所，在淮安路之白水塘、黃家疃等處，為戶一萬五千九百九十四名，為田三萬五千三百一十二頃二十一畝。

translations.literal: The sites were at Baitang and Huangjiatuan in Huai'an Circuit—15,994 households and 35,312 qing 21 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Sites lay at Baitang and Huangjiatuan in Huai'an Circuit—15,994 households and 35,312 qing and 21 mu.

sentences.zh: 芍陂屯田萬戶府：世祖至元二十一年二月，江淮行省言：「安豐之芍陂，可溉田萬餘頃，乞置三萬人立屯。」

translations.literal: Shaoqi Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office: In the second month of the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat said: "Shaoqi of Anfeng can irrigate more than ten thousand qing; we request thirty thousand men to establish a garrison."
translations.idiomatic: Shaoqi Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office: In the second month of the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan, the Jianghuai branch secretariat proposed: "Shaoqi at Anfeng can irrigate more than ten thousand qing; we request thirty thousand men for a garrison."

sentences.zh: 中書省議：「發軍士二千人，姑試行之。」

translations.literal: The Secretariat deliberated: "Send two thousand soldiers to try it first."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat replied: "Send two thousand soldiers for a trial first."

sentences.zh: 後屯戶至一萬四千八百八名。

translations.literal: Later garrison households reached 14,808.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison households later reached 14,808.

sentences.zh: 德安等處軍民屯田總管府：世祖至元十八年，以各翼取到漢軍，及各路拘收手號新附軍，分置十屯，立屯田萬戶府。

translations.literal: De'an and Elsewhere Military and Civilian Garrison-Farming Chief Office: In the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, Han troops obtained from the various wings and newly attached troops with hand-brand registers seized by the various circuits were distributed into ten garrisons, and a Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: De'an Military and Civilian Garrison-Farming Chief Office: In the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan, Han troops drawn from the various wings and hand-brand newly attached troops seized from the circuits were organized into ten garrisons under a Garrison-Farming Ten-Thousand-Household Office.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，改立總管府，為民九千三百七十五名，軍五千九百六十五名，為田八千八百七十九頃九十六畝。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year it was changed to a chief office—9,375 civilians, 5,965 soldiers, and 8,879 qing 96 mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year it became a chief office—9,375 civilians, 5,965 soldiers, and 8,879 qing and 96 mu.

sentences.zh: 陜西等處行中書省所轄軍民屯田

translations.literal: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 陜西屯田總管府：世祖至元十一年正月，以安西王府所管編民二千戶，立櫟陽、涇陽、終南、渭南屯田。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Garrison-Farming Chief Office: In the first month of the eleventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, two thousand registered households under the Anxi Princely Establishment were put to garrison farming at Liyang, Jingyang, Zhongnan, and Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Garrison-Farming Chief Office: In the first month of the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, two thousand registered households under the Anxi princely establishment were settled for garrison farming at Liyang, Jingyang, Zhongnan, and Weinan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，立屯田所。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year a Garrison-Farming Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year a Garrison-Farming Office was established.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以軍站屯戶拘收為怯憐口戶計，放還而無所歸者，籍為屯戶，立安西、平涼屯田，設提領所以領之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, because garrison households of military relay stations were seized to meet qaljin household quotas, those released who had nowhere to return were registered as garrison households; garrison farms were established at Anxi and Pingliang, with a supervisory office to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, because relay-station garrison households were seized to fill qaljin household quotas, those released with nowhere to go were registered as garrison households; farms were established at Anxi and Pingliang under a supervisory office.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，立鳳翔、鎮原、彭原屯田，放罷至元十年所簽接應成都、延安軍人，置立民屯，設立屯田所，尋改為軍屯，令千戶所管領。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year garrison farms were established at Fengxiang, Zhenyuan, and Pengyuan; soldiers levied in the tenth year of Zhiyuan to relieve Chengdu and Yan'an were released, civilian garrisons were set up with Garrison-Farming Offices, soon changed to military garrisons under thousand-household offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year garrisons were established at Fengxiang, Zhenyuan, and Pengyuan; soldiers levied in the tenth year of Zhiyuan for Chengdu and Yan'an relief were released, civilian garrisons with Garrison-Farming Offices were set up, and soon converted to military garrisons under thousand-household offices.

sentences.zh: 三十年，復更為民屯，為戶鳳翔一千一百二十七戶；

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year they were again changed to civilian garrisons—Fengxiang, 1,127 households;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year they reverted to civilian garrisons—Fengxiang: 1,127 households;

sentences.zh: 鎮原九百一十三戶；

translations.literal: Zhenyuan, 913 households;
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan: 913 households;

sentences.zh: 櫟陽七百八十六戶，後存六百五十戶；

translations.literal: Liyang, 786 households, later 650 remained;
translations.idiomatic: Liyang: 786 households, later reduced to 650;

sentences.zh: 涇陽六百九十六戶，後存六百五十八戶；

translations.literal: Jingyang, 696 households, later 658 remained;
translations.idiomatic: Jingyang: 696 households, later reduced to 658;

sentences.zh: 彭原一千二百三十八戶；

translations.literal: Pengyuan, 1,238 households;
translations.idiomatic: Pengyuan: 1,238 households;

sentences.zh: 安西七百二十四戶，後存二百六十二戶；

translations.literal: Anxi, 724 households, later 262 remained;
translations.idiomatic: Anxi: 724 households, later reduced to 262;

sentences.zh: 平涼二百八十八戶；

translations.literal: Pingliang, 288 households;
translations.idiomatic: Pingliang: 288 households;

sentences.zh: 終南七百七十一戶，後存七百一十三戶；

translations.literal: Zhongnan, 771 households, later 713 remained;
translations.idiomatic: Zhongnan: 771 households, later reduced to 713;

sentences.zh: 渭南八百一十一戶，後存七百六十六戶。

translations.literal: Weinan, 811 households, later 766 remained.
translations.idiomatic: Weinan: 811 households, later reduced to 766.

sentences.zh: 為田鳳翔九十頃一十二畝，鎮原四百二十六頃八十五畝，櫟陽一千二十頃九十九畝，涇陽一千二十頃九十九畝，彭原五百四十五頃六十八畝，安西四百六十七頃七十八畝，平涼一百一十五頃二十畝，終南九百四十三頃七十六畝，渭南一千二百二十二頃三十一畝。

translations.literal: Fields: Fengxiang, 90 qing 12 mu; Zhenyuan, 426 qing 85 mu; Liyang, 1,020 qing 99 mu; Jingyang, 1,020 qing 99 mu; Pengyuan, 545 qing 68 mu; Anxi, 467 qing 78 mu; Pingliang, 115 qing 20 mu; Zhongnan, 943 qing 76 mu; Weinan, 1,222 qing 31 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Fields totaled: Fengxiang, 90 qing and 12 mu; Zhenyuan, 426 qing and 85 mu; Liyang, 1,020 qing and 99 mu; Jingyang, 1,020 qing and 99 mu; Pengyuan, 545 qing and 68 mu; Anxi, 467 qing and 78 mu; Pingliang, 115 qing and 20 mu; Zhongnan, 943 qing and 76 mu; Weinan, 1,222 qing and 31 mu.

sentences.zh: 陜西等處萬戶府屯田：世祖至元十九年二月，以盩厔南系官荒地，發歸附軍，立孝子林、張馬村軍屯。

translations.literal: Shaanxi and Elsewhere Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the second month of the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, on state wasteland south of Zhouzhi, newly submitted troops were dispatched to establish military garrisons at Xiaozilin and Zhangmacun.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the second month of the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, newly submitted troops were sent to open military garrisons at Xiaozilin and Zhangmacun on state wasteland south of Zhouzhi.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以南山把口子巡哨軍人八百戶，於盩厔之杏園莊、寧州之大昌原屯田。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, eight hundred households of pass-guard patrol soldiers from the southern mountains were put to garrison farming at Xingyuanzhuang in Zhouzhi and Dachangyuan in Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, eight hundred households of southern-mountain pass-guard patrol soldiers were settled at Xingyuanzhuang in Zhouzhi and Dachangyuan in Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，發文州鎮戍新附軍九百人，立亞柏鎮軍屯，復以燕京戍守新附軍四百六十三戶，於德順州之威戎立屯開耕。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, nine hundred newly attached garrison troops from Wenzhou were sent to establish the Yabozhen military garrison; four hundred sixty-three households of newly attached Yanjing garrison troops were also put to open cultivation at Weirong in Deshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, nine hundred Wenzhou garrison troops established the Yabozhen military garrison, and four hundred sixty-three households of newly attached Yanjing garrison troops opened fields at Weirong in Deshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 為戶孝子林屯三百一戶，張馬村屯三百一十三戶，杏園莊屯二百三十三戶，大昌原屯四百七十四戶，亞柏鎮屯九百戶，威戎屯四百六十三戶。

translations.literal: Households: Xiaozilin garrison, 301; Zhangmacun garrison, 313; Xingyuanzhuang garrison, 233; Dachangyuan garrison, 474; Yabozhen garrison, 900; Weirong garrison, 463.
translations.idiomatic: Households: Xiaozilin, 301; Zhangmacun, 313; Xingyuanzhuang, 233; Dachangyuan, 474; Yabozhen, 900; Weirong, 463.

sentences.zh: 為田孝子林二十三頃八十畝，張馬村七十三頃八十畝，杏園莊一百一十八頃三十畝，大昌原一百五十八頃七十九畝，亞柏鎮二百六十八頃五十九畝，威戎一百六十四頃八十畝。

translations.literal: Fields: Xiaozilin, 23 qing 80 mu; Zhangmacun, 73 qing 80 mu; Xingyuanzhuang, 118 qing 30 mu; Dachangyuan, 158 qing 79 mu; Yabozhen, 268 qing 59 mu; Weirong, 164 qing 80 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Fields: Xiaozilin, 23 qing and 80 mu; Zhangmacun, 73 qing and 80 mu; Xingyuanzhuang, 118 qing and 30 mu; Dachangyuan, 158 qing and 79 mu; Yabozhen, 268 qing and 59 mu; Weirong, 164 qing and 80 mu.

sentences.zh: 貴赤延安總管府屯：世祖至元十九年，以拘收贖身、放良、不蘭奚及漏籍戶計，於延安路探馬赤草地屯田，為戶二千二十七，為田四百八十六頃。

translations.literal: Keshig Yan'an Chief Office Garrison: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, ransomed, released, Bulanxi, and unregistered households were seized and put to garrison farming on tamachi pastureland in Yan'an Circuit—2,027 households and 486 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Keshig Yan'an Chief Office Garrison: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, ransomed, released, Bulanxi, and unregistered households were settled on tamachi pastureland in Yan'an Circuit—2,027 households and 486 qing.

sentences.zh: 甘肅等處行中書省所轄軍民屯田

translations.literal: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Gansu Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Gansu Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 寧夏等處新附軍萬戶府屯田：世祖至元十九年三月，發迤南新附軍一千三百八十二戶，往寧夏等處屯田。

translations.literal: Ningxia and Elsewhere Newly Attached Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the third month of the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, 1,382 households of newly attached troops from the far south were sent to garrison farming in Ningxia and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia Newly Attached Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the third month of the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, 1,382 households of far-southern newly attached troops were sent to farm in Ningxia and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，遣塔塔裏千戶所管軍人九百五十八戶屯田，為田一千四百九十八頃三十三畝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, 958 households of soldiers under the Tatali thousand-household office were dispatched to garrison farming—1,498 qing 33 mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, 958 households under the Tatali thousand-household office were sent to farm—1,498 qing and 33 mu.

sentences.zh: 管軍萬戶府屯田：世祖至元十八年正月，命肅州、沙州、瓜州置立屯田。

translations.literal: Garrison Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, garrison farming was ordered established at Suzhou, Shazhou, and Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan, garrison farming was ordered at Suzhou, Shazhou, and Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 先是，遣都元帥劉恩往肅州諸郡，視地之所宜，恩還言宜立屯田，遂從之。

translations.literal: Previously, Grand Marshal Liu En had been sent to the prefectures of Suzhou to inspect suitable land; on his return he reported that garrison farming should be established, and the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Grand Marshal Liu En had surveyed the Suzhou prefectures for suitable land; on his return he recommended garrison farming, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 發軍於甘州黑山子、滿峪、泉水渠、鴨子翅等處立屯，為戶二千二百九十，為田一千一百六十六頃六十四畝。

translations.literal: Troops were dispatched to establish garrisons at Heishanzi, Manyu, Quanshuiqu, and Yazichi in Ganzhou—2,290 households and 1,166 qing 64 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were settled at Heishanzi, Manyu, Quanshuiqu, and Yazichi in Ganzhou—2,290 households and 1,166 qing and 64 mu.

sentences.zh: 寧夏營田司屯田：世祖至元八年正月，簽發己未年隨州、鄂州投降人民一千一百七戶，往中興居住。

translations.literal: Ningxia Camp-Field Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the eighth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, 1,117 households of people who had surrendered from Suizhou and Ezhou in the jiwei year were levied to settle at Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia Camp-Field Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the eighth year of Zhiyuan, 1,117 households of jiwei-year surrenderers from Suizhou and Ezhou were settled at Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 十一年，編為屯田戶，凡二千四百丁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year they were registered as garrison-farming households—2,400 adult males in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year they were registered as garrison-farming households—2,400 adult males in all.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，續簽漸丁，得三百人，為田一千八百頃。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year additional young males were levied, yielding three hundred men—1,800 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year three hundred additional young males were levied—1,800 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 寧夏路放良官屯田：世祖至元十一年，從安撫司請，以招收放良人民九百四戶，編聚屯田，為田四百四十六頃五十畝。

translations.literal: Ningxia Circuit Released-Bondservant Official Garrison Farm: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, at the request of the Pacification Commission, 904 households of released people were gathered for garrison farming—446 qing 50 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia Circuit Released-Bondservant Official Garrison Farm: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, at the pacification commission's request, 904 released households were gathered to farm—446 qing and 50 mu.

sentences.zh: 亦集乃屯田：世祖至元十六年，調歸附軍人於甘州，十八年，以充屯田軍。

translations.literal: Yijinai Garrison Farm: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, newly submitted soldiers were transferred to Ganzhou; in the eighteenth year they were assigned as garrison-farming troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yijinai Garrison Farm: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan, newly submitted soldiers were transferred to Ganzhou; in the eighteenth year they became garrison-farming troops.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，遷甘州新附軍二百人，往屯亦集乃合即渠開種，為田九十一頃五十畝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, two hundred newly attached troops from Ganzhou were moved to farm and open fields at the Heji Canal in Yijinai—91 qing 50 mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, two hundred newly attached Ganzhou troops were moved to open fields at the Heji Canal in Yijinai—91 qing and 50 mu.

sentences.zh: 江西等處行中書省所轄屯田

translations.literal: Garrison Farms under the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Farms under the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 贛州路南安寨兵萬戶府屯田：成宗大德二年正月，以贛州路所轄信豐、會昌、龍南、安遠等處，賊人出沒，發寨兵及宋舊役弓手，與抄數漏籍人戶，立屯耕守，以鎮遏之，為戶三千二百六十五，為田五百二十四頃六十八畝。

translations.literal: Ganzhou Circuit Nan'an Stockade Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the second year of Dade under Chengzong, because bandits appeared in Xinfeng, Huichang, Longnan, Anyuan, and elsewhere under Ganzhou Circuit, stockade troops and former Song bowmen were dispatched together with unregistered households seized by census to garrison, farm, and hold the region—3,265 households and 524 qing 68 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou Nan'an Stockade Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Garrison Farm: In the first month of the second year of Dade, because bandits roamed Xinfeng, Huichang, Longnan, and Anyuan under Ganzhou Circuit, stockade troops, former Song bowmen, and seized unregistered households were settled to farm and guard the region—3,265 households and 524 qing and 68 mu.

sentences.zh: 江浙等處行中書省所轄屯田

translations.literal: Garrison Farms under the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Farms under the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 汀、漳屯田：世祖至元十八年，以福建調軍糧儲費用，依腹裏例，置立屯田，命管軍總管鄭楚等，發鎮守士卒年老不堪備征戰者，得百有十四人，又募南安等縣居民一千八百二十五戶，立屯耕作。

translations.literal: Ting and Zhang Garrison Farms: In the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, because Fujian troop deployments were costly in grain, garrison farming was established following the interior precedent; Garrison Commander Zheng Chu and others were ordered to send aged garrison soldiers unfit for campaign, numbering one hundred fourteen, and to recruit 1,825 households of residents from Nan'an and other counties for garrison cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Ting and Zhang Garrison Farms: In the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan, because Fujian troop deployments strained grain supplies, garrison farming was established on the interior model; Commander Zheng Chu sent one hundred fourteen aged garrison soldiers unfit for battle and recruited 1,825 households from Nan'an and other counties to farm.

sentences.zh: 成宗元貞三年，命於南詔、黎、畬各立屯田，摘撥見戍軍人，每屯置一千五百名，及將所招陳吊眼等余黨入屯，與軍人相參耕種。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanzhen under Chengzong, garrison farms were ordered established at Nanzhao, Li, and She; garrison soldiers on duty were selected, fifteen hundred men per garrison, and remnants of Chen Diaoyan's faction were enrolled to farm alongside the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanzhen, garrisons were ordered at Nanzhao, Li, and She; fifteen hundred active garrison soldiers were assigned to each, and remnants of Chen Diaoyan's faction were enrolled to farm with them.

sentences.zh: 為戶汀州屯一千五百二十五名，漳州屯一千五百一十三名。

translations.literal: Households: Tingzhou garrison, 1,525; Zhangzhou garrison, 1,513.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel: Tingzhou garrison, 1,525; Zhangzhou garrison, 1,513.

sentences.zh: 為田汀州屯二百二十五頃，漳州屯二百五十頃。

translations.literal: Fields: Tingzhou garrison, 225 qing; Zhangzhou garrison, 250 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Fields: Tingzhou, 225 qing; Zhangzhou, 250 qing.

sentences.zh: 高麗國立屯

translations.literal: Goryeo State Garrison Farms
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo State Garrison Farms

sentences.zh: 高麗屯田：世祖至元七年創立，是時東征日本，欲積糧餉，為進取之計，遂以王綧、洪茶丘等所管高麗戶二千人，及發中衛軍二千人，合婆娑府、咸平府軍各一千人，於王京東寧府、鳳州等一十處，置立屯田，設經略司以領其事，每屯用軍五百人。

translations.literal: Goryeo Garrison Farm: Established in the seventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, when the eastern expedition against Japan was planned and grain stores were to be accumulated for the advance; two thousand Goryeo households under Wang Chuo, Hong Chaqian, and others and two thousand Central Guard soldiers, together with one thousand soldiers each from Posuo Prefecture and Xianping Prefecture, were sent to ten sites including Dongning Prefecture and Fengzhou in the royal capital region; a pacification office was established to supervise, with five hundred soldiers per garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo Garrison Farm: Founded in the seventh year of Zhiyuan during preparations for the eastern expedition against Japan to stock grain for the advance; two thousand Goryeo households under Wang Chuo and Hong Chaqian, two thousand Central Guard soldiers, and one thousand each from Posuo and Xianping prefectures were settled at ten sites including Dongning Prefecture and Fengzhou near the royal capital under a pacification office, with five hundred soldiers per garrison.

sentences.zh: 四川行省所轄軍民屯田二十九處

translations.literal: Twenty-nine Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Sichuan Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-nine Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Sichuan Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 廣元路民屯：世祖至元十三年，從利州路元帥言，廣元實東西兩川要沖，支給浩繁，經理系官田畝，得九頃六十畝，遂以褒州刷到無主人口，偶配為十戶，立屯開種。

translations.literal: Guangyuan Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, following the Lizhou Circuit commander's memorial, because Guangyuan was a vital junction of the eastern and western Sichuan routes with heavy expenditures, state fields were surveyed and 9 qing 60 mu obtained; unregistered people seized from Baozhou were paired into ten households to open a garrison farm.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, at the Lizhou commander's request, because Guangyuan was a vital junction of eastern and western Sichuan with heavy costs, state fields were surveyed yielding 9 qing and 60 mu; unregistered people from Baozhou were paired into ten households to open farming.

sentences.zh: 十八年，發新得州編民七十七戶屯田，為戶共八十七。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, seventy-seven registered households from Xinde Prefecture were levied for garrison farming—eighty-seven households in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, seventy-seven registered households from Xinde Prefecture were added—eighty-seven households in all.

sentences.zh: 敘州宣撫司民屯：世祖至元十一年，命西蜀四川經略使起立屯田。

translations.literal: Xuzhou Pacification Commission Civilian Garrison: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, the Western Sichuan pacification commissioner was ordered to establish garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou Pacification Commission Civilian Garrison: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, the Western Sichuan pacification commissioner was ordered to establish garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 十五年，簽長寧軍、富順州等處編民四百七十五戶，立屯耕種。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, four hundred seventy-five registered households from Changning Army and Fushun Prefecture and elsewhere were levied to establish garrison cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, four hundred seventy-five registered households from Changning Army and Fushun Prefecture were levied to farm.

sentences.zh: 十九年，續簽一百六十戶。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, one hundred sixty households were additionally levied.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, one hundred sixty more households were levied.

sentences.zh: 二十年，敘州簽民一千九百戶。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Xuzhou levied one thousand nine hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, Xuzhou levied one thousand nine hundred households.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，富順州復簽民六百八戶，增人舊屯。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Fushun Prefecture again levied six hundred eight households to augment the old garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Fushun Prefecture levied six hundred eight more households for the existing garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，取勘析出屯戶，得二百八十四。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, garrison households found by investigation totaled two hundred eighty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, investigation yielded two hundred eighty-four garrison households.

sentences.zh: 成宗元貞二年，復放罷站戶一千一十七戶，依舊屯田。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanzhen under Chengzong, one thousand seventeen relay households were again released and returned to garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanzhen, one thousand seventeen relay households were released and returned to garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 總之為戶四千四百四十四。
