translations.literal: In all, 4,444 households.
translations.idiomatic: In all, 4,444 households.

sentences.zh: 紹慶路民屯：世祖至元十九年，於本路未當差民戶內，簽二十三戶，置立屯田。

translations.literal: Shaoqing Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, twenty-three households not yet liable for corvée within this circuit were levied to establish a garrison farm.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoqing Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, twenty-three corvée-exempt households within the circuit were levied for a garrison farm.

sentences.zh: 二十年，於彭水縣籍管萬州寄戶內，簽撥二十戶。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, twenty households were selected from Wanzhou registered dependents in Pengshui County.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, twenty households were selected from Wanzhou dependents registered in Pengshui County.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，簽彭水縣未當差民戶三十二戶增入。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, thirty-two corvée-exempt households in Pengshui County were levied as additions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, thirty-two corvée-exempt Pengshui households were added.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，屯戶貧乏者多負逋，復簽彭水縣編民一十六戶補之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, because many garrison households were impoverished and in arrears, sixteen registered households in Pengshui County were levied to replenish them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, because many garrison households were impoverished and in debt, sixteen Pengshui registered households were levied as replacements.

sentences.zh: 為戶九十一。

translations.literal: Households totaled ninety-one.
translations.idiomatic: Households totaled ninety-one.

sentences.zh: 順慶路民屯：世祖至元十二年，簽順慶民三千四百六十八戶，置立屯田。

translations.literal: Shunqing Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, three thousand four hundred sixty-eight Shunqing households were levied to establish a garrison farm.
translations.idiomatic: Shunqing Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, three thousand four hundred sixty-eight Shunqing households were levied for a garrison farm.

sentences.zh: 十九年，復於民戶內差撥一千三百三十六戶置民屯。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, one thousand three hundred thirty-six civilian households were again selected and assigned to a civilian garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, one thousand three hundred thirty-six more civilian households were assigned to a civilian garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十年，復簽二百一十二戶增入。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, two hundred twelve households were additionally levied.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, two hundred twelve more households were levied.

sentences.zh: 總之五千一十六戶。

translations.literal: In all, 5,016 households.
translations.idiomatic: In all, 5,016 households.

sentences.zh: 潼州府民屯：世祖至元十一年，簽本府編民及義士軍二千二百二十四戶，立屯。

translations.literal: Tongzhou Prefecture Civilian Garrison: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, two thousand two hundred twenty-four registered households and volunteer soldiers of this prefecture were levied to establish a garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou Prefecture Civilian Garrison: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, two thousand two hundred twenty-four registered households and volunteer soldiers of the prefecture were levied for a garrison.

sentences.zh: 十三年，復簽民一百四十二戶。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, one hundred forty-two civilian households were additionally levied.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, one hundred forty-two more civilian households were levied.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，行省遣使於遂寧府擇監夫之老弱廢疾者，得四十六戶，簽充屯戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the branch secretariat sent envoys to Suining Prefecture to select aged, weak, and disabled transport overseers, obtaining forty-six households registered as garrison households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, the branch secretariat selected aged, weak, and disabled transport overseers in Suining Prefecture, registering forty-six as garrison households.

sentences.zh: 總之二千四百一十二戶。

translations.literal: In all, 2,412 households.
translations.idiomatic: In all, 2,412 households.

sentences.zh: 夔路總管府民屯：世祖至元十一年置，累簽本路編民至五千二十七戶，續於新附軍內簽老弱五十六戶增入。

translations.literal: Kuizhou Circuit Chief Office Civilian Garrison: Established in the eleventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu; registered households of this circuit were repeatedly levied until they reached five thousand twenty-seven, and fifty-six aged and weak men were additionally selected from newly attached troops.
translations.idiomatic: Kuizhou Circuit Chief Office Civilian Garrison: Established in the eleventh year of Zhiyuan; registered households were repeatedly levied until they reached five thousand twenty-seven, with fifty-six aged and weak newly attached troops added.

sentences.zh: 重慶路民屯：世祖至元十一年置，累於江津、巴縣、瀘州、忠州等處，簽撥編民二千三百八十七戶，並召募，共三千五百六十六戶。

translations.literal: Chongqing Circuit Civilian Garrison: Established in the eleventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu; registered households were repeatedly selected and assigned at Jiangjin, Baxian, Luzhou, Zhongzhou, and elsewhere—two thousand three hundred eighty-seven households—and with recruitment totaled three thousand five hundred sixty-six households.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing Circuit Civilian Garrison: Established in the eleventh year of Zhiyuan; two thousand three hundred eighty-seven registered households were levied at Jiangjin, Baxian, Luzhou, Zhongzhou, and elsewhere, and with recruits totaled three thousand five hundred sixty-six households.

sentences.zh: 成都路民屯：世祖至元十三年，簽陰陽人四十戶，辦納屯糧。

translations.literal: Chengdu Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, forty yin-yang specialist households were levied to deliver garrison grain.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu Circuit Civilian Garrison: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, forty yin-yang specialist households were levied to supply garrison grain.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，續簽瀘州編民九十七戶，充屯田戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, ninety-seven registered households from Luzhou were additionally levied as garrison-farming households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, ninety-seven Luzhou registered households were added as garrison-farming households.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，續簽千戶高德所管民一十四戶。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, fourteen civilian households under Thousand-Household Gao De were additionally levied.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, fourteen civilian households under Thousand-Household Gao De were added.

sentences.zh: 保寧萬戶府軍屯：世祖至元二十六年，保寧府言：「本管軍人，一戶或二丁三丁，父兄子弟應役，實為重並，若又遷於成都屯種，去家隔遠，逃匿必多。

translations.literal: Baoning Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, Baoning Prefecture said: "The soldiers under our command often have two or three adult males per household serving together; the burden is truly heavy. If they are also moved to farm at Chengdu, they will be far from home and desertion will surely be frequent.
translations.idiomatic: Baoning Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan, Baoning Prefecture memorialized: "Our soldiers often have two or three adult males per household on duty at once—a truly heavy burden. If they are also moved to farm at Chengdu, they will be far from home and desertions will surely multiply.

sentences.zh: 乞令本府在營士卒，及夔路守鎮軍人，止於保寧沿江屯種。」

translations.literal: We request that soldiers of this prefecture in camp and garrison troops of Kuizhou Route farm only along the river at Baoning."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that this prefecture's camp soldiers and Kuizhou garrison troops farm only along the Baoning riverfront."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 簽軍一千二百名。

translations.literal: One thousand two hundred soldiers were levied.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand two hundred soldiers were levied.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，發屯軍一百二十九人，從萬戶也速叠兒西征，別簽漸丁軍人入屯，為戶一千三百二十九名，為田一百一十八頃二十七畝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, one hundred twenty-nine garrison soldiers were sent on the western campaign under Ten-Thousand-Household Yesu Die'er; replacement young soldiers were levied for the garrison—1,329 households and 118 qing 27 mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, one hundred twenty-nine garrison soldiers joined Ten-Thousand-Household Yesu Die'er's western campaign; young replacements were levied—1,329 households and 118 qing and 27 mu.

sentences.zh: 敘州等處萬戶府軍屯：成宗元貞二年，改立敘州軍屯，遷遂寧屯軍二百三十九人，於敘州宣化縣喁口上下荒地開耕，為田四十一頃八十三畝。

translations.literal: Xuzhou and Elsewhere Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the second year of Yuanzhen under Chengzong, the Xuzhou military garrison was reorganized; two hundred thirty-nine garrison soldiers from Suining were moved to open wasteland above and below Yongkou in Xuanhua County, Xuzhou—41 qing 83 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the second year of Yuanzhen, the Xuzhou military garrison was reorganized; two hundred thirty-nine Suining garrison soldiers were moved to open wasteland at Yongkou in Xuanhua County, Xuzhou—41 qing and 83 mu.

sentences.zh: 重慶五路守鎮萬戶府軍屯：仁宗延祐七年，發軍一千二百人，於重慶路三堆、中曹、趙市等處屯耕，為田四百二十頃。

translations.literal: Chongqing Five-Circuit Garrison Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the seventh year of Yanyou under Renzong, one thousand two hundred soldiers were dispatched to farm at Sandui, Zhongcao, Zhaoshi, and elsewhere in Chongqing Circuit—420 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing Five-Circuit Garrison Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the seventh year of Yanyou, one thousand two hundred soldiers were sent to farm at Sandui, Zhongcao, and Zhaoshi in Chongqing Circuit—420 qing.

sentences.zh: 夔路萬戶府軍屯：世祖至元二十一年，從四川行省議，除沿邊重地，分軍鎮守，余軍一萬人，命官於成都諸處擇膏腴地，立屯開耕，為戶三百五十一人，為田五十六頃七十畝，凡創立十四屯。

translations.literal: Kuizhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, following deliberation by the Sichuan branch secretariat, except for troops guarding critical border posts, the remaining ten thousand soldiers were ordered to select fertile land around Chengdu and establish garrisons—351 households, 56 qing 70 mu, fourteen garrisons established in all.
translations.idiomatic: Kuizhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan, on the Sichuan branch secretariat's recommendation, aside from border garrisons, ten thousand remaining soldiers were ordered to select fertile land near Chengdu—351 households, 56 qing and 70 mu, fourteen garrisons in all.

sentences.zh: 成都等路萬戶府軍屯：於本路崇慶州義興鄉楠木園置立，為戶二百九十九人，為田四十二頃七十畝。

translations.literal: Chengdu and Other Circuits Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Nanmuyuan, Yixing Township, Chongqing Prefecture—299 households and 42 qing 70 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu Circuits Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Nanmuyuan, Yixing Township, Chongqing Prefecture—299 households and 42 qing and 70 mu.

sentences.zh: 河東陜西等路萬戶府軍屯：置立於灌州之青城、陶壩及崇慶州之大柵頭等處，為戶一千三百二十八名，為田二百八頃七畝。

translations.literal: Hedong-Shaanxi and Other Circuits Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng and Taoba in Guanzhou and Dazhaitou in Chongqing Prefecture—1,328 households and 208 qing 7 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong-Shaanxi Circuits Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng and Taoba in Guanzhou and Dazhaitou in Chongqing Prefecture—1,328 households and 208 qing and 7 mu.

sentences.zh: 廣安等處萬戶府軍屯：置立於成都路崇慶州之七寶壩，為戶一百五十名，為田二十六頃二十五畝。

translations.literal: Guang'an and Elsewhere Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qibaoba in Chongqing Prefecture—150 households and 26 qing 25 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Guang'an Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qibaoba in Chongqing Prefecture—150 households and 26 qing and 25 mu.

sentences.zh: 保寧萬戶府軍屯：置立於崇慶州晉原縣之金馬，為戶五百六十四名，為田七十五頃九十五畝。

translations.literal: Baoning Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Jinma, Jinyuan County, Chongqing Prefecture—564 households and 75 qing 95 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Baoning Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Jinma in Jinyuan County, Chongqing Prefecture—564 households and 75 qing and 95 mu.

sentences.zh: 敘州萬戶府軍屯：置立於灌州之青城，為戶二百二十一名，為田三十八頃六十七畝。

translations.literal: Xuzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng in Guanzhou—221 households and 38 qing 67 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng in Guanzhou—221 households and 38 qing and 67 mu.

sentences.zh: 五路萬戶府軍屯：置立於成都路崇慶州之大柵鎮孝感鄉及灌州青城縣之懷仁鄉，為戶一千一百六十一名，為田二百三頃一十七畝。

translations.literal: Five-Circuit Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Dazhai Town, Xiaogan Township, Chongqing Prefecture, and Huairen Township, Qingcheng County, Guanzhou—1,161 households and 203 qing 17 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Five-Circuit Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Dazhai Town, Xiaogan Township, Chongqing Prefecture, and Huairen Township, Qingcheng County, Guanzhou—1,161 households and 203 qing and 17 mu.

sentences.zh: 興元金州等處萬戶府軍屯：置立於崇慶州晉原縣孝感鄉，為戶三百四十四名，為田五十六頃。

translations.literal: Xingyuan-Jinzhou and Elsewhere Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Xiaogan Township, Jinyuan County, Chongqing Prefecture—344 households and 56 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyuan-Jinzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Xiaogan Township, Jinyuan County, Chongqing Prefecture—344 households and 56 qing.

sentences.zh: 隨路八都萬戶府軍屯：置立於灌州青城、溫江縣，為戶八百三十二名，為田一百六十二頃五十七畝。

translations.literal: Circuit Eight-Banner Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng in Guanzhou and Wenjiang County—832 households and 162 qing 57 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit Eight-Banner Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng in Guanzhou and Wenjiang County—832 households and 162 qing and 57 mu.

sentences.zh: 舊附等軍萬戶府軍屯：置立於灌州青城縣、崇慶州等處，為戶一千二名，為田一百二十九頃五十畝。

translations.literal: Formerly Attached Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng County, Guanzhou, and Chongqing Prefecture and elsewhere—1,002 households and 129 qing 50 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Attached Troops Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng County, Guanzhou, and Chongqing Prefecture—1,002 households and 129 qing and 50 mu.

sentences.zh: 炮手萬戶府軍屯：置立於灌州青城縣龍池鄉，為戶九十六名，為田一十六頃八十畝。

translations.literal: Artillerymen Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Longchi Township, Qingcheng County, Guanzhou—96 households and 16 qing 80 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Artillerymen Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: Established at Longchi Township, Qingcheng County, Guanzhou—96 households and 16 qing and 80 mu.

sentences.zh: 順慶軍屯：置立於晉原縣義興鄉、江源縣將軍橋，為戶五百六十五名，為田九十八頃八十七畝。

translations.literal: Shunqing Military Garrison: Established at Yixing Township, Jinyuan County, and Jiangqiao, Jiangyuan County—565 households and 98 qing 87 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Shunqing Military Garrison: Established at Yixing Township, Jinyuan County, and Jiangqiao, Jiangyuan County—565 households and 98 qing and 87 mu.

sentences.zh: 平陽軍屯：置立於灌州青城、崇慶州大柵頭，為戶三百九十八名，為田六十九頃六十五畝。

translations.literal: Pingyang Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng in Guanzhou and Dazhaitou in Chongqing Prefecture—398 households and 69 qing 65 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang Military Garrison: Established at Qingcheng in Guanzhou and Dazhaitou in Chongqing Prefecture—398 households and 69 qing and 65 mu.

sentences.zh: 遂寧州軍屯：為戶二千名，為田三百五十頃。

translations.literal: Suining Prefecture Military Garrison: 2,000 households and 350 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Suining Prefecture Military Garrison: 2,000 households and 350 qing.

sentences.zh: 嘉定萬戶府軍屯：世祖至元二十一年，摘蒙古、漢軍及嘉定新附軍三百六十人，於崇慶州、青城等處屯田。

translations.literal: Jiading Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, three hundred sixty Mongol, Han, and newly attached Jiading soldiers were selected to garrison farm at Chongqing Prefecture, Qingcheng, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan, three hundred sixty Mongol, Han, and newly attached Jiading soldiers were sent to farm at Chongqing Prefecture and Qingcheng.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，還之元翼，止余屯軍一十三名，為田二頃二十七畝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year they were returned to their original wing; only thirteen garrison soldiers remained—2 qing 27 mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year they were returned to their original wing; only thirteen garrison soldiers remained—2 qing and 27 mu.

sentences.zh: 順慶等處萬戶府軍屯：世祖至元二十六年，發軍於沿江下流漢初等處屯種，為戶六百五十六名，為田一百一十四頃八十畝。

translations.literal: Shunqing and Elsewhere Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, soldiers were dispatched to farm at Hanchu and elsewhere along the lower river—656 households and 114 qing 80 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Shunqing Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan, soldiers were sent to farm at Hanchu and other lower-river sites—656 households and 114 qing and 80 mu.

sentences.zh: 廣安等處萬戶府軍屯：世祖至元二十七年，撥廣安舊附漢軍一百一十八名，於新明等處立屯開耕，為田二十頃六十五畝。

translations.literal: Guang'an and Elsewhere Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, one hundred eighteen formerly attached Han soldiers from Guang'an were assigned to establish garrison cultivation at Xinming and elsewhere—20 qing 65 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Guang'an Ten-Thousand-Household Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, one hundred eighteen formerly attached Han soldiers from Guang'an opened fields at Xinming and elsewhere—20 qing and 65 mu.

sentences.zh: 雲南行省所轄軍民屯田一十二處

translations.literal: Twelve Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Yunnan Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Military and Civilian Garrison Farms under the Yunnan Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 威楚提舉司屯田：世祖至元十五年，於威楚提舉鹽使司拘刷漏籍人戶充民屯，本司就領其事，與中原之制不同，為戶三十三，為田一百六十五雙。

translations.literal: Weichu Intendant's Office Garrison Farm: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, unregistered households seized by the Weichu Salt Intendant's Office were assigned as a civilian garrison; the office itself supervised the work, differing from the interior system—33 households and 165 shuang of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Weichu Intendant's Office Garrison Farm: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, unregistered households seized by the Weichu Salt Intendant's Office were assigned as a civilian garrison supervised by that office itself, unlike the interior system—33 households and 165 shuang.

sentences.zh: 大理金齒等處宣尉司都元帥府軍民屯：世祖至元十二年，命於所轄州縣拘刷漏籍人戶，得二千六十有六戶，置立屯田。

translations.literal: Dali Golden Teeth and Elsewhere Pacification Commission Grand Marshal's Office Military and Civilian Garrison: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, an order was issued to seize unregistered households in the subordinate prefectures and counties; 2,066 households were obtained and garrison farming was established.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Golden Teeth Pacification Commission Grand Marshal's Office Garrison: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, unregistered households were rounded up across its prefectures and counties—2,066 households—and garrison farming was established.

sentences.zh: 十四年，簽本府編民四百戶益之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, four hundred registered civilians from this office were conscripted to augment it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, four hundred registered civilians from this office were conscripted to augment it.

sentences.zh: 十八年，續簽永昌府編民一千二百七十五戶增入。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, an additional one thousand two hundred seventy-five registered civilians from Yongchang Prefecture were conscripted and added.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, another 1,275 registered civilians from Yongchang Prefecture were conscripted and added.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，立大理軍屯，於爨僰軍內撥二百戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, a Dali military garrison was established; two hundred households were drawn from within the Cuan-Bo troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, a Dali military garrison was established with two hundred households drawn from Cuan-Bo troops.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，復簽爨僰軍人二百八十一戶增入。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, a further two hundred eighty-one Cuan-Bo soldiers were conscripted and added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, another 281 Cuan-Bo soldiers were conscripted and added.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，續增一百一十九戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, another one hundred nineteen households were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, another 119 households were added.

sentences.zh: 總之民屯三千七百四十一戶，軍屯六百戶，為田軍民己業二萬二千一百五雙。

translations.literal: In all, civilian garrison three thousand seven hundred forty-one households, military garrison six hundred households; fields for military and civilian own land totaled twenty-two thousand one hundred five shuang.
translations.idiomatic: In all: 3,741 civilian garrison households and 600 military garrison households; fields for military and civilian own land totaled 22,105 shuang.

sentences.zh: 鶴慶路軍民屯田：世祖至元十二年，簽鶴慶路編民一百戶立民屯。

translations.literal: Heqing Circuit Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, one hundred registered civilians from Heqing Circuit were conscripted to establish a civilian garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing Circuit Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, one hundred registered civilians from Heqing Circuit were conscripted to establish a civilian garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，簽爨僰軍一百五十二戶立軍屯，為田軍屯六百八雙，民屯四百雙，俱己業。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, one hundred fifty-two Cuan-Bo soldiers were conscripted to establish a military garrison; fields were six hundred eight shuang for the military garrison and four hundred shuang for the civilian garrison, all own land.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, 152 Cuan-Bo soldiers were conscripted for a military garrison—608 shuang for the military garrison and 400 shuang for the civilian garrison, all privately held land.

sentences.zh: 武定路總管府軍屯：世祖至元二十七年，以雲南戍軍糧餉不足，於和曲、祿勸二州爨僰軍內，簽一百八十七戶，立屯耕種，為田七百四十八雙。

translations.literal: Wuding Circuit Chief Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, because Yunnan garrison troops' grain rations were insufficient, within the Cuan-Bo troops of Hequ and Lujuan prefectures one hundred eighty-seven households were conscripted to establish garrison cultivation—seven hundred forty-eight shuang of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Wuding Circuit Chief Office Military Garrison: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, because Yunnan garrison rations were insufficient, 187 households from Cuan-Bo troops in Hequ and Lujuan were conscripted to farm—748 shuang.

sentences.zh: 威楚路軍民屯田：世祖至元十二年，立威楚民屯，拘刷本路漏籍人戶，得一千一百戶，內八百六十六戶官給無主荒田四千三百三十雙，餘戶自備己業田一千一百七十五雙。

translations.literal: Weichu Circuit Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, a Weichu civilian garrison was established; unregistered households of this circuit were seized, obtaining one thousand one hundred households—of these eight hundred sixty-six households were given ownerless wasteland by the state, four thousand three hundred thirty shuang, and the remaining households supplied their own own-land fields, one thousand one hundred seventy-five shuang.
translations.idiomatic: Weichu Circuit Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, a Weichu civilian garrison was established by rounding up unregistered households—1,100 in all; 866 received 4,330 shuang of ownerless wasteland from the state, and the rest farmed 1,175 shuang of their own land.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，始立屯軍，於本路爨僰軍內簽三百九十九戶，內一十五戶官給荒田六十雙，余戶自備己業田一千五百三十六雙。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, a garrison army was first established; within this circuit's Cuan-Bo troops three hundred ninety-nine households were conscripted—of these fifteen households were given wasteland by the state, sixty shuang, and the remaining households supplied their own own-land fields, one thousand five hundred thirty-six shuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, a military garrison was first established with 399 Cuan-Bo soldiers from this circuit—15 received 60 shuang of state-granted wasteland, and the rest farmed 1,536 shuang of their own land.

sentences.zh: 中慶路軍民屯田：世祖至元十二年，置立中慶民屯，於所屬州縣內拘刷漏籍人戶，得四千一百九十七戶，官給田一萬七千二十二雙，自備己業田二千六百二雙。

translations.literal: Zhongqing Circuit Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, a Zhongqing civilian garrison was established; within its subordinate prefectures and counties unregistered households were seized, obtaining four thousand one hundred ninety-seven households—state-granted fields ten thousand seven hundred twenty-two shuang, and self-supplied own-land fields two thousand six hundred two shuang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqing Circuit Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, a Zhongqing civilian garrison was established by rounding up unregistered households in its subordinate prefectures and counties—4,197 households, with 17,022 shuang of state-granted fields and 2,602 shuang of privately held land.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，始立軍屯，用爨僰軍人七百有九戶，官給田二百三十四雙，自備己業田二千六百一雙。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, a military garrison was first established, using seven hundred nine Cuan-Bo soldiers; state-granted fields two hundred thirty-four shuang, and self-supplied own-land fields two thousand six hundred one shuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, a military garrison was first established with 709 Cuan-Bo soldiers—234 shuang of state-granted fields and 2,601 shuang of privately held land.

sentences.zh: 曲靖等處宣慰司兼管軍萬戶府軍民屯田：世祖至元十二年，立曲靖路民屯，拘刷所轄州郡諸色漏籍人戶七百四十戶立屯。

translations.literal: Qujing and Elsewhere Pacification Commission Also Commanding the Ten-Thousand-Household Military Office Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, a Qujing Circuit civilian garrison was established; seven hundred forty households of every sort of unregistered persons in the subordinate prefectures and districts were seized to establish the garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Qujing Pacification Commission Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, a Qujing civilian garrison was established with 740 unregistered households rounded up from its subordinate prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 十八年，續簽民一千五百戶增入，其所耕之田，官給一千四百八十雙，自備己業田三千雙。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, an additional one thousand five hundred civilian households were conscripted and added; the fields they cultivated were one thousand four hundred eighty shuang state-granted and three thousand shuang self-supplied own land.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, another 1,500 civilian households were conscripted and added, farming 1,480 shuang of state-granted fields and 3,000 shuang of privately held land.

sentences.zh: 十二年，立澂江民屯，所簽屯戶，與曲靖同，凡一千二百六十戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, a Chengjiang civilian garrison was established; the garrison households conscripted were the same as Qujing's, one thousand two hundred sixty households in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, a Chengjiang civilian garrison was established with the same conscription arrangement as Qujing—1,260 households in all.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，始立軍屯，於爨僰軍內簽一百六十九戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, a military garrison was first established; within the Cuan-Bo troops one hundred sixty-nine households were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, a military garrison was first established with 169 households conscripted from Cuan-Bo troops.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，復簽二百二十六戶增入。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, a further two hundred twenty-six households were conscripted and added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, another 226 households were conscripted and added.

sentences.zh: 十二年，立仁德府民屯，所簽屯戶，與澂江同，凡八十戶，官給田一百六十雙。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, a Rende Prefecture civilian garrison was established; the garrison households conscripted were the same as Chengjiang's, eighty households in all, with one hundred sixty shuang of state-granted fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, a Rende Prefecture civilian garrison was established on the same terms as Chengjiang—80 households with 160 shuang of state-granted fields.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，始立軍屯，簽爨僰軍四十四戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, a military garrison was first established; forty-four Cuan-Bo soldiers were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, a military garrison was first established with 44 Cuan-Bo soldiers conscripted.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，續簽五十六戶增入，所耕田畝四百雙，俱系軍人己業。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, a further fifty-six households were conscripted and added; the fields cultivated were four hundred shuang, all being soldiers' own land.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, another 56 households were conscripted and added, farming 400 shuang—all soldiers' privately held land.

sentences.zh: 烏撒宣慰司軍民屯田：世祖至元二十七年，立烏撒路軍屯，以爨僰軍一百一十四戶屯田。

translations.literal: Wusa Pacification Commission Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, a Wusa Circuit military garrison was established; one hundred fourteen Cuan-Bo households garrison-farmed.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa Pacification Commission Garrison Farm: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, a Wusa military garrison was established with 114 Cuan-Bo households farming.

sentences.zh: 又立東川路民屯，屯戶亦系爨僰軍人，八十六戶，皆自備己業。

translations.literal: A Dongchuan Circuit civilian garrison was also established; the garrison households were likewise Cuan-Bo soldiers, eighty-six households, all self-supplying own land.
translations.idiomatic: A Dongchuan civilian garrison was also established with 86 Cuan-Bo soldiers as garrison households, all farming their own land.

sentences.zh: 臨安宣慰司兼管軍萬戶府軍民屯田：世祖至元十二年，立臨安民屯二處，皆於所屬州縣拘刷漏籍人戶開耕。

translations.literal: Lin'an Pacification Commission Also Commanding the Ten-Thousand-Household Military Office Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, two Lin'an civilian garrisons were established; both opened cultivation by seizing unregistered households in the subordinate prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an Pacification Commission Garrison Farm: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, two Lin'an civilian garrisons were established, opening fields with unregistered households rounded up from its subordinate prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 宣慰司所管民屯三百戶，田六百雙。

translations.literal: The pacification commission directly supervised civilian garrison three hundred households, fields six hundred shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commission directly supervised 300 civilian garrison households and 600 shuang of fields.

sentences.zh: 本路所管民屯二千戶，田三千四百雙。

translations.literal: The circuit directly supervised civilian garrison two thousand households, fields three thousand four hundred shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit directly supervised 2,000 civilian garrison households and 3,400 shuang of fields.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，續立爨僰軍屯，為戶二百八十八，為田一千一百五十二雙。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, a Cuan-Bo military garrison was further established—two hundred eighty-eight households and one thousand one hundred fifty-two shuang of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, a Cuan-Bo military garrison was added—288 households and 1,152 shuang of fields.

sentences.zh: 梁千戶翼軍屯：世祖至元三十年，梁王遣使詣雲南行省言，以漢軍一千人置立屯田。

translations.literal: Liang Thousand-Household Wing Military Garrison: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, the Prince of Liang sent envoys to the Yunnan branch secretariat stating that one thousand Han soldiers should be assigned to establish garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Thousand-Household Wing Military Garrison: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan, the Prince of Liang sent envoys to the Yunnan branch secretariat requesting that 1,000 Han soldiers be assigned to establish garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，發三百人備鎮戍巡邏，止存七百人，於烏蒙屯田，後遷於新興州，為田三千七百八十九雙。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, three hundred men were dispatched for garrison defense and border patrol; only seven hundred remained to garrison-farm at Wumeng, later moved to Xinxing Prefecture—three thousand seven hundred eighty-nine shuang of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, 300 men were sent for garrison duty and border patrol, leaving 700 to farm at Wumeng; they were later moved to Xinxing Prefecture—3,789 shuang of fields.

sentences.zh: 羅羅斯宣慰司兼管軍萬戶府軍民屯田：世祖至元二十七年，立會通民屯，屯戶系爨僰土軍二戶。

translations.literal: Luoluo Pacification Commission Also Commanding the Ten-Thousand-Household Military Office Military and Civilian Garrison Farm: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, a Huitong civilian garrison was established; the garrison households were two local Cuan-Bo soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Luoluo Pacification Commission Garrison Farm: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, a Huitong civilian garrison was established with two local Cuan-Bo soldiers as garrison households.

sentences.zh: 十六年，立建昌民屯，撥編民一百四戶。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, a Jianchang civilian garrison was established; one hundred four registered civilians were assigned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, a Jianchang civilian garrison was established with 104 registered civilians assigned.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，發爨僰軍一百八十戶，立軍屯。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, one hundred eighty Cuan-Bo soldiers were dispatched to establish a military garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, 180 Cuan-Bo soldiers were dispatched to establish a military garrison.

sentences.zh: 是年，又立會川路民屯，發本路所轄州邑編民四十戶。

translations.literal: That year, a Huichuan Circuit civilian garrison was also established; forty registered civilians from the prefectures and districts under this circuit were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, a Huichuan civilian garrison was also established with 40 registered civilians dispatched from prefectures and districts under the circuit.

sentences.zh: 十六年，立德昌路民屯，發編民二十一戶。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, a Dechang Circuit civilian garrison was established; twenty-one registered civilians were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, a Dechang civilian garrison was established with 21 registered civilians dispatched.

sentences.zh: 二十年，始立軍屯，發爨僰軍人一百二十戶。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, a military garrison was first established; one hundred twenty Cuan-Bo soldiers were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, a military garrison was first established with 120 Cuan-Bo soldiers dispatched.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙等處屯田總管府軍屯：仁宗延祐三年，立烏蒙軍屯。

translations.literal: Wumeng and Elsewhere Garrison Farm Chief Office Military Garrison: In the third year of Yanyou under Renzong, a Wumeng military garrison was established.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng Garrison Farm Chief Office Military Garrison: In the third year of Yanyou, a Wumeng military garrison was established.

sentences.zh: 先是雲南行省言：「烏蒙乃雲南咽喉之地，別無屯戍軍馬，其地廣闊，土脈膏腴，皆有古昔屯田之跡，乞發畏吾兒及新附漢軍屯田鎮遏。」

translations.literal: Previously the Yunnan branch secretariat stated: "Wumeng is the throat of Yunnan; there are no garrison troops stationed there. Its land is vast and broad, the soil rich and fertile, and everywhere there are traces of garrison farming from antiquity. We request dispatch of Uighur and newly attached Han soldiers for garrison farming to secure and suppress the region."
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Yunnan branch secretariat had argued: "Wumeng is the strategic throat of Yunnan, yet has no garrison troops; the land is vast and fertile, with traces of ancient garrison farming everywhere. We request Uighur and newly attached Han soldiers for garrison farming to secure the region."

sentences.zh: 至是從之。

translations.literal: At this point the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was then approved.

sentences.zh: 為戶軍五千人，為田一千二百五十頃。

translations.literal: Households were five thousand soldiers; fields were one thousand two hundred fifty qing.
translations.idiomatic: This came to 5,000 soldier households and 1,250 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 湖廣等處行中書省所轄屯田三處

translations.literal: Three Garrison Farms under the Huguang Branch Secretariat
translations.idiomatic: Three Garrison Farms under the Huguang Branch Secretariat

sentences.zh: 海北海南道宣慰司都元帥府民屯：世祖至元三十年，召募民戶並發新附士卒，於海南、海北等處置立屯田。

translations.literal: Haibei-Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission Grand Marshal's Office Civilian Garrison: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, civilian households were recruited and newly attached soldiers dispatched to establish garrison farms at Hainan, Haibei, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Haibei-Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission Civilian Garrison: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan, civilian households were recruited and newly attached soldiers dispatched to establish garrison farms in Hainan, Haibei, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 成宗元貞元年，以其地多瘴癘，縱屯田軍二千人還各翼，留二千人與召募民之屯種。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen under Chengzong, because the region had much miasma and pestilence, two thousand garrison soldiers were released back to their respective wings; two thousand were retained to farm together with recruited civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanzhen, because the region was heavily malarial, 2,000 garrison soldiers were released to their original wings, leaving 2,000 to farm with recruited civilians.

sentences.zh: 大德三年，罷屯田萬戶府，屯軍悉令還役，止令民戶八千四百二十八戶屯田，瓊州路五千一十一戶，雷州路一千五百六十六戶，高州路九百四十八戶，化州路八百四十三戶，廉州路六十戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade, the garrison-farm ten-thousand-household office was abolished; all garrison soldiers were ordered back to regular service, and only eight thousand four hundred twenty-eight civilian households were left to garrison-farm—Qiongzhou Circuit five thousand eleven households, Leizhou Circuit one thousand five hundred sixty-six households, Gaozhou Circuit nine hundred forty-eight households, Huazhou Circuit eight hundred forty-three households, Lianzhou Circuit sixty households.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade, the garrison-farm ten-thousand-household office was abolished and all garrison soldiers returned to regular service; only 8,428 civilian households remained to farm—5,011 in Qiongzhou, 1,566 in Leizhou, 948 in Gaozhou, 843 in Huazhou, and 60 in Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 為田瓊州路二百九十二頃九十八畝，雷州路一百六十五頃五十一畝，高州路四十五頃，化州路五十五頃二十四畝，廉州路四頃八十八畝。

translations.literal: Fields were Qiongzhou Circuit two hundred ninety-two qing ninety-eight mu, Leizhou Circuit one hundred sixty-five qing fifty-one mu, Gaozhou Circuit forty-five qing, Huazhou Circuit fifty-five qing twenty-four mu, Lianzhou Circuit four qing eighty-eight mu.
translations.idiomatic: Fields totaled 292 qing and 98 mu in Qiongzhou, 165 qing and 51 mu in Leizhou, 45 qing in Gaozhou, 55 qing and 24 mu in Huazhou, and 4 qing and 88 mu in Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 廣西兩江道宣慰司都元帥撞兵屯田：成宗大德二年，黃聖許叛，逃之交趾，遺棄水田五百四十五頃七畝。

translations.literal: Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit Pacification Commission Grand Marshal's Office Zhuang Soldier Garrison Farm: In the second year of Dade under Chengzong, Huang Shengxu rebelled, fled to Annam, and abandoned five hundred forty-five qing seven mu of paddy fields.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit Pacification Commission Zhuang Soldier Garrison Farm: In the second year of Dade, Huang Shengxu rebelled, fled to Annam, and abandoned 545 qing and 7 mu of paddy fields.

sentences.zh: 部民有呂瑛者，言募牧蘭等處及融慶溪洞徭、撞民丁，於上浪、忠州諸處開屯耕種。

translations.literal: Among the subjects there was one Lü Ying, who proposed recruiting labor from pastoral areas such as Mulan and Yao and Zhuang commoners from cave settlements in Rongqing to open garrison farms and cultivate at Shanglang, Zhongzhou, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: A subject named Lü Ying proposed recruiting Zhuang and Yao labor from pastoral areas such as Mulan and cave settlements in Rongqing to open garrison farms at Shanglang, Zhongzhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 十年，平大任洞賊黃德寧等，以其地所遺田土，續置藤州屯田。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the bandits Huang De'ning and others at Daren Cave were pacified; the abandoned fields and land there were used to establish a further Tengzhou garrison farm.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, after suppressing the bandits Huang De'ning and others at Daren Cave, an additional Tengzhou garrison farm was established on the abandoned lands.

sentences.zh: 為戶上浪屯一千二百八十二戶，忠州屯六百一十四戶，那扶屯一千九戶，雷留屯一百八十七戶，水口屯一千五百九十九戶。

translations.literal: Households were Shanglang garrison one thousand two hundred eighty-two households, Zhongzhou garrison six hundred fourteen households, Nafu garrison one thousand nine households, Leiliu garrison one hundred eighty-seven households, Shuikou garrison one thousand five hundred ninety-nine households.
translations.idiomatic: Households totaled 1,282 at Shanglang, 614 at Zhongzhou, 1,919 at Nafu, 187 at Leiliu, and 1,599 at Shuikou.

sentences.zh: 續增藤州屯，二百八頃一十九畝。

translations.literal: Tengzhou garrison was further augmented—two hundred eight qing nineteen mu.
translations.idiomatic: Tengzhou garrison was further expanded by 208 qing and 19 mu.

sentences.zh: 湖南道宣慰司衡州等處屯田：世祖至元二十五年，調德安屯田萬戶府軍士一千四百六十七名，分置衡州之清化、永州之烏符、武岡之白倉，置立屯田。

translations.literal: Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission Hengzhou and Elsewhere Garrison Farm: In the twenty-fifth year of Zhiyuan under Shizu, one thousand four hundred sixty-seven soldiers from the De'an Garrison-Farm Ten-Thousand-Household Office were transferred and distributed to Qinghua in Hengzhou, Wufu in Yongzhou, and Baicang in Wugang to establish garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission Hengzhou Garrison Farm: In the twenty-fifth year of Zhiyuan, 1,467 soldiers from the De'an Garrison-Farm Ten-Thousand-Household Office were redeployed to Qinghua in Hengzhou, Wufu in Yongzhou, and Baicang in Wugang to establish garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，募衡陽縣無土產居民，得九戶，增入清化屯。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, residents of Hengyang County without land of their own were recruited; nine households were obtained and added to Qinghua garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, nine landless residents of Hengyang County were recruited and added to Qinghua garrison.

sentences.zh: 為戶清化屯軍民五百九戶；

translations.literal: Households were Qinghua garrison five hundred nine military and civilian households;
translations.idiomatic: Households totaled 509 military and civilian households at Qinghua;

sentences.zh: 烏符屯軍民五百戶，白倉屯同。

translations.literal: Wufu garrison five hundred military and civilian households; Baicang garrison the same.
translations.idiomatic: 500 military and civilian households at Wufu, and the same at Baicang.

sentences.zh: 為田清化屯一百二十頃一十九畝，烏符屯一百三頃五十畝，白倉屯八十六頃九十二畝。

translations.literal: Fields were Qinghua garrison one hundred twenty qing nineteen mu, Wufu garrison one hundred three qing fifty mu, Baicang garrison eighty-six qing ninety-two mu.
translations.idiomatic: Fields totaled 120 qing and 19 mu at Qinghua, 103 qing and 50 mu at Wufu, and 86 qing and 92 mu at Baicang.
